chat.title: Coach interview

questions.goals: What's your main goal? Pick one or more.
questions.schedule: Where do you train, how long, and how often?
questions.focus: What do you want to improve?
questions.body: Which body model fits you? Height and weight are optional; I use them to pick the model closest to you.
questions.bodyChild: Which body model should we show?
questions.bodyTeen: Which body model fits you? Pick the one closest to you.

chat.focusMarked: I marked it on your body map: {{list}}.
chat.focusDeferred: No problem. You'll tap the muscles on the body map next.
chat.notUnderstood: I didn't quite get that. Pick from the options, or try other words.
chat.understood: Got it. Check the options below and continue.
chat.offline: I couldn't reach your coach just now, so I only understand short answers. Pick from the options below.

safety.name: Safety check
safety.title: Anything we should work around?
safety.noteOk: Great. You can always add pain or injuries later, or tap “I feel pain” during a workout.
safety.redFlagBody: Some of your answers mean you should check with your doctor before your first workout. You can still set up your plan now.
safety.footnote: TapStrong adapts training; it doesn't give medical advice.

march_in_place.name: March in place
march_in_place.cues: Lift your knees at an easy pace and swing your arms.

seated_march.name: Seated march
seated_march.cues: Sit tall and lift one knee, then the other, at an easy pace.

jumping_jacks.name: Jumping jacks
jumping_jacks.cues: Jump feet apart as arms go up, then back together. Land softly.

brisk_walk.name: Brisk walk
brisk_walk.cues: Walk at a pace where you can still talk.

arm_circles.name: Arm circles
arm_circles.cues: Draw slow circles with straight arms, forward then back.

band_pull_apart.name: Band pull-apart
band_pull_apart.cues: Hold the band at chest height and pull it apart, squeezing your shoulder blades.

leg_swings.name: Leg swings
leg_swings.cues: Hold a support and swing one leg forward and back, relaxed.

hip_circles.name: Hip circles
hip_circles.cues: Hands on hips, draw slow circles with your hips both ways.

cat_cow.name: Cat-cow
cat_cow.cues: On hands and knees, round your back, then gently arch it.

torso_twist.name: Torso twist
torso_twist.cues: Turn your upper body side to side, hips facing forward.

push_up.name: Push-up
push_up.cues: Body in a straight line; lower your chest to the floor and press up.

wall_push_up.name: Wall push-up
wall_push_up.cues: Hands on a wall at chest height; bend your elbows and push back.

feet_elevated_push_up.name: Feet-elevated push-up
feet_elevated_push_up.cues: Feet on a bench, body straight; lower your chest and press up.

incline_dumbbell_press.name: Incline dumbbell press 30°
incline_dumbbell_press.cues: Elbows at 45°. Lower to the upper chest, press up and in slightly.

flat_dumbbell_press.name: Flat dumbbell press
flat_dumbbell_press.cues: Lower the dumbbells beside your chest and press up.

low_to_high_cable_fly.name: Low-to-high cable fly
low_to_high_cable_fly.cues: Bring the handles up and together in an arc to eye level.

high_to_low_cable_fly.name: High-to-low cable fly
high_to_low_cable_fly.cues: Bring the handles down and together in front of your hips.

seated_chest_press_machine.name: Seated chest press machine
seated_chest_press_machine.cues: Back on the pad; press the handles forward and return slowly.

dumbbell_shoulder_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell_shoulder_press.cues: Press the dumbbells overhead without arching your back.

band_front_raise.name: Band front raise
band_front_raise.cues: Raise straight arms to shoulder height and lower slowly.

band_face_pull.name: Band face pull
band_face_pull.cues: Pull the band toward your face, elbows high and out.

one_arm_dumbbell_row.name: One-arm dumbbell row
one_arm_dumbbell_row.cues: Hand on the bench; pull the dumbbell to your hip.

band_row.name: Band row
band_row.cues: Pull the band to your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat_pulldown.cues: Pull the bar to your upper chest, chest up.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated cable row
seated_cable_row.cues: Sit tall and pull the handle to your belly.

dumbbell_shrug.name: Dumbbell shrug
dumbbell_shrug.cues: Lift your shoulders toward your ears, pause, lower.

superman.name: Superman
superman.cues: Lying face down, lift arms and legs a little, then lower.

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long.

dumbbell_curl.name: Dumbbell curl
dumbbell_curl.cues: Elbows by your sides; curl up and lower slowly.

band_curl.name: Band curl
band_curl.cues: Stand on the band and curl your hands to your shoulders.

overhead_dumbbell_triceps_extension.name: Overhead triceps extension
overhead_dumbbell_triceps_extension.cues: Hold a dumbbell overhead; lower behind your head and extend.

bench_dip.name: Bench dip
bench_dip.cues: Hands on the bench behind you; bend your elbows and press up.

band_triceps_pushdown.name: Band triceps pushdown
band_triceps_pushdown.cues: Elbows fixed at your sides; push the band down.

dumbbell_wrist_curl.name: Dumbbell wrist curl
dumbbell_wrist_curl.cues: Forearms on your thighs; curl the dumbbells with your wrists.

plank.name: Plank
plank.cues: Elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Breathe.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.cues: On your back, lower the opposite arm and leg, low back down.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.cues: Knees bent; curl your shoulders off the floor, then lower.

reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
reverse_crunch.cues: On your back, curl your knees toward your chest.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.cues: On one elbow, lift your hips into a straight line.

band_pallof_press.name: Band Pallof press
band_pallof_press.cues: Band at your side; press it straight out and resist the twist.

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweight_squat.cues: Sit back and down, knees over toes, then stand.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet_squat.cues: Hold a dumbbell at your chest; squat down and stand tall.

sit_to_stand.name: Sit to stand
sit_to_stand.cues: From a chair, stand up without using your hands, then sit slowly.

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.cues: Step back and lower both knees, then return.

leg_press.name: Leg press
leg_press.cues: Feet hip-width; lower with control and press away.

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.cues: On your back, drive through your heels and lift your hips.

dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell_romanian_deadlift.cues: Soft knees; hinge at the hips, dumbbells close to your legs.

lying_hamstring_curl_machine.name: Lying hamstring curl
lying_hamstring_curl_machine.cues: Curl your heels toward your glutes and lower slowly.

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing calf raise
standing_calf_raise.cues: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly.

seated_knee_raise.name: Seated knee raise
seated_knee_raise.cues: Sit tall and lift one knee toward your chest.

side_lying_adductor_raise.name: Side-lying inner thigh raise
side_lying_adductor_raise.cues: Lying on your side, lift the bottom leg a little.

wall_tibialis_raise.name: Wall tibialis raise
wall_tibialis_raise.cues: Back on a wall, lift your toes up and lower.

band_terminal_knee_extension.name: Band knee extension
band_terminal_knee_extension.cues: Band behind your knee; straighten the knee against it.

step_up.name: Step-up
step_up.cues: Step onto the bench, stand tall, step down with control.

single_leg_balance.name: Single-leg balance
single_leg_balance.cues: Stand on one leg; hold a support if you need it.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain climber
mountain_climber.cues: In a plank, drive your knees in, one after the other.

doorway_chest_stretch.name: Doorway chest stretch
doorway_chest_stretch.cues: Forearm on a door frame; lean forward gently.

cross_body_shoulder_stretch.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cross_body_shoulder_stretch.cues: Pull one arm across your chest with the other.

overhead_triceps_stretch.name: Overhead triceps stretch
overhead_triceps_stretch.cues: Hand behind your head; gently press the elbow.

standing_quad_stretch.name: Standing quad stretch
standing_quad_stretch.cues: Hold a support; pull your heel toward your glute.

seated_hamstring_stretch.name: Seated hamstring stretch
seated_hamstring_stretch.cues: Leg straight; lean forward from the hips.

seated_figure_four_stretch.name: Seated figure-four stretch
seated_figure_four_stretch.cues: Ankle over the other knee; lean forward gently.

wall_calf_stretch.name: Wall calf stretch
wall_calf_stretch.cues: Hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel down.

childs_pose.name: Child's pose
childs_pose.cues: Sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward.

kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.cues: One knee down; shift your hips forward gently.

upper_trap_stretch.name: Upper trap stretch
upper_trap_stretch.cues: Tilt your ear toward your shoulder; relax.

standing_side_stretch.name: Side stretch
standing_side_stretch.cues: Reach one arm overhead and lean to the side.

hug_upper_back_stretch.name: Upper back hug stretch
hug_upper_back_stretch.cues: Hug yourself and round your upper back.

biceps_wall_stretch.name: Biceps wall stretch
biceps_wall_stretch.cues: Palm on a wall behind you; turn away slowly.

box_breathing.name: Slow breathing
box_breathing.cues: Breathe in for 4, hold 4, out for 4, hold 4.

neutral_grip_floor_press.name: Neutral-grip floor press
neutral_grip_floor_press.cues: Lie on the floor, palms facing each other; lower until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up.

neutral_grip_machine_chest_press.name: Neutral-grip machine chest press
neutral_grip_machine_chest_press.cues: Palms facing in, handles at mid-chest; press out without locking your elbows, stop before your hands pass your chest on the way back.

short_range_incline_push_up.name: Short-range incline push-up
short_range_incline_push_up.cues: Hands on a bench, body straight; lower only halfway, then push back up.

iso_shoulder_external_rotation.name: Wall press, arm turning out
iso_shoulder_external_rotation.cues: Elbow bent at your side, back of the hand against a wall. Press gently outward without moving. Hold 20–30 s.

iso_shoulder_internal_rotation.name: Doorframe press, arm turning in
iso_shoulder_internal_rotation.cues: Elbow bent at your side, palm against a doorframe. Press gently inward without moving. Hold 20–30 s.

iso_shoulder_abduction.name: Wall press, arm to the side
iso_shoulder_abduction.cues: Stand side-on to a wall, elbow bent, outer elbow against it. Press gently out without moving. Hold 20–30 s.

iso_shoulder_flexion.name: Wall press, arm forward
iso_shoulder_flexion.cues: Face a wall, elbow bent, fist against it. Press gently forward without moving. Hold 20–30 s.

band_external_rotation.name: Band external rotation
band_external_rotation.cues: Elbow bent at your side, band in hand. Turn the forearm out slowly, only in the pain-free range.

quad_set.name: Thigh squeeze
quad_set.cues: Sit with the leg straight. Tighten the front of the thigh, pressing the knee down. Hold 10 s, relax.

chin_tuck.name: Chin tuck
chin_tuck.cues: Sit tall. Slide the chin straight back, making a double chin, without tilting. Hold 5 s.

iso_wrist_extension.name: Wrist press, back of hand
iso_wrist_extension.cues: Forearm on a table, palm down. Press the back of the hand up into your other hand without moving. Hold 20–30 s.

knee_push_up.name: Knee push-up
knee_push_up.cues: Keep a straight line from knees to head and lower your chest between your hands.

close_grip_push_up.name: Close-grip push-up
close_grip_push_up.cues: Hands under your shoulders, elbows close to your ribs; lower with control and push back up.

close_grip_knee_push_up.name: Close-grip knee push-up
close_grip_knee_push_up.cues: On your knees, hands under your shoulders, keep elbows tucked in as you lower and press up.

close_grip_wall_push_up.name: Close-grip wall push-up
close_grip_wall_push_up.cues: Hands on the wall at shoulder height and close together; bend elbows along your sides and push away.

incline_push_up.name: Counter incline push-up
incline_push_up.cues: Hands on a sturdy counter or table edge, body straight; lower your chest to the edge and press away.

wide_incline_push_up.name: Wide incline push-up
wide_incline_push_up.cues: Hands a little wider than shoulders on a sturdy table; lower slowly and stop before shoulders ache.

incline_push_up_hold.name: Incline push-up hold
incline_push_up_hold.cues: Hands on a sturdy counter, lower halfway and hold still with your body straight, breathing steadily.

step_decline_push_up.name: Step decline push-up
step_decline_push_up.cues: Feet on a low stair step, hands on the floor; keep your body straight and lower your chest slowly.

decline_push_up_hold.name: Decline push-up hold
decline_push_up_hold.cues: Feet on a low step, lower halfway and hold with a straight body; come down to your knees to rest.

reverse_grip_wall_push_up.name: Reverse-grip wall push-up
reverse_grip_wall_push_up.cues: Hands low on the wall with fingers pointing down; keep elbows close and press up and away from the wall.

dive_bomber_push_up.name: Dive-bomber push-up
dive_bomber_push_up.cues: From a hips-high position, swoop your chest low and forward between your hands, then reverse it slowly.

pike_push_up.name: Pike push-up
pike_push_up.cues: Hips high in an upside-down V; bend elbows to bring the top of your head toward the floor, then press up.

airplane_arm_hold.name: Airplane arm hold
airplane_arm_hold.cues: Lift both arms out to the sides at shoulder height, thumbs up, and hold them still like airplane wings.

upward_palm_press_hold.name: Upward palm press hold
upward_palm_press_hold.cues: Press palms together in front of your face, angled slightly up, and squeeze hard while you breathe.

palm_press_hold.name: Chest palm press hold
palm_press_hold.cues: Press palms together in front of your chest, elbows out, and squeeze steadily without holding your breath.

downward_palm_press_hold.name: Low palm press hold
downward_palm_press_hold.cues: Press palms together at belly height, pointing slightly down, and squeeze while breathing normally.

seated_push_up.name: Seated chair push-up
seated_push_up.cues: Sit on a sturdy chair with armrests, press down through your hands and lift your hips slightly, then lower.

wall_triceps_extension.name: Wall triceps extension
wall_triceps_extension.cues: Forearms on the wall above your head, lean in, then straighten your elbows to push your body back.

self_resisted_triceps_press.name: Self-resisted triceps press
self_resisted_triceps_press.cues: Push one hand down to straighten the arm while the other hand resists it; go slowly, then switch.

table_row.name: Under-table row
table_row.cues: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge, keep your body straight and pull your chest up toward it.

underhand_table_row.name: Underhand table row
underhand_table_row.cues: Under a sturdy table, grip the edge palms facing you and pull your chest up, elbows close to your body.

doorframe_row.name: Doorframe row
doorframe_row.cues: Hold both sides of a sturdy doorframe, lean back with straight arms, then pull your chest toward the door.

single_arm_doorframe_row.name: One-arm doorframe row
single_arm_doorframe_row.cues: Hold a sturdy doorframe with one hand, lean back, and pull your elbow toward your hip without twisting.

towel_lat_pulldown.name: Towel lat pulldown
towel_lat_pulldown.cues: Hold a towel overhead pulled tight, then draw your elbows down to your ribs while keeping it tight.

prone_lat_pulldown.name: Floor lat pulldown
prone_lat_pulldown.cues: Lie face down, arms overhead just off the floor, and pull your elbows down to your sides, then reach again.

prone_t_raise.name: Floor T raise
prone_t_raise.cues: Lie face down, arms out in a T with thumbs up, and lift them a little by squeezing your shoulder blades.

prone_y_raise.name: Floor Y raise
prone_y_raise.cues: Lie face down, arms in a Y shape with thumbs up, and lift them gently while keeping your neck long.

prone_w_raise.name: Floor W raise
prone_w_raise.cues: Lie face down with elbows bent into a W and lift your arms slightly, pulling shoulder blades together.

prone_cobra.name: Floor cobra hold
prone_cobra.cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides, lift your chest a little and draw shoulder blades back and down; hold.

wall_y_lift_off.name: Wall Y lift-off
wall_y_lift_off.cues: Face a wall, hands on it in a Y shape, and lift your hands just off the wall using your upper back.

scapular_squeeze.name: Shoulder blade squeeze
scapular_squeeze.cues: Sit or stand tall, squeeze your shoulder blades back and down, hold, then relax without shrugging.

wall_elbow_press_hold.name: Wall elbow press hold
wall_elbow_press_hold.cues: Back to a wall or chair back, elbows bent at your sides; press elbows back into it and hold.

towel_pull_apart_hold.name: Towel pull-apart hold
towel_pull_apart_hold.cues: Hold a towel at chest height with straight arms and try to pull it apart; keep shoulders down.

doorframe_face_pull.name: Doorframe face pull
doorframe_face_pull.cues: Hold a sturdy doorframe at face height, lean back, and pull your face toward it with elbows high and wide.

doorframe_curl.name: Doorframe biceps curl
doorframe_curl.cues: Hold a sturdy doorframe palms up, lean back with straight arms, then curl your body toward the frame.

towel_curl.name: Towel foot curl
towel_curl.cues: Sit, loop a towel under one foot and curl the ends up while that foot presses down to resist.

self_resisted_curl.name: Self-resisted biceps curl
self_resisted_curl.cues: Curl one arm up while the other hand presses down on the wrist to resist; move slowly, then switch.

under_table_curl_hold.name: Under-table curl hold
under_table_curl_hold.cues: Sit at a sturdy table, palms up under its edge, elbows bent, and press up steadily without shrugging.

towel_wring.name: Towel wring
towel_wring.cues: Hold a rolled towel with both hands and twist it like wringing out water, then twist the other way.

self_resisted_wrist_extension.name: Self-resisted wrist lift
self_resisted_wrist_extension.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm down; lift the back of the hand while the other hand gently resists.

self_resisted_wrist_flexion.name: Self-resisted wrist curl
self_resisted_wrist_flexion.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm up; curl the hand up while the other hand gently presses it down.

fist_squeeze_hold.name: Fist squeeze hold
fist_squeeze_hold.cues: Make tight fists, or squeeze a rolled sock, and hold the squeeze while breathing steadily.

chair_pike_push_up.name: Chair pike push-up
chair_pike_push_up.cues: Hands on a sturdy chair seat, hips high, bend elbows to lower your head toward the seat, then press up.

front_arm_hold.name: Front arm hold
front_arm_hold.cues: Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height, thumbs up, and hold them still while breathing.

seated_scapular_dip.name: Seated shoulder blade dip
seated_scapular_dip.cues: Hands on sturdy armrests, arms straight; push your shoulders down away from your ears, then let them rise.

doorframe_grip_hold.name: Doorframe grip hold
doorframe_grip_hold.cues: Grip the edge of a sturdy doorframe with both hands, lean back slightly and hold with a firm grip.

low_to_high_band_fly.name: Low-to-high band fly
low_to_high_band_fly.cues: Anchor the band low, arms slightly bent, and sweep your hands up and together to eye level.

seated_low_to_high_band_fly.name: Seated low-to-high band fly
seated_low_to_high_band_fly.cues: Sit tall with the band under the chair legs and sweep your hands up and together in front of your face.

band_incline_press.name: Band incline press
band_incline_press.cues: Anchor the band low behind you and press your hands forward and up to eye level, then return slowly.

seated_band_incline_press.name: Seated band incline press
seated_band_incline_press.cues: Sit with the band around the chair back and press up and forward at a slight angle, then return.

single_arm_band_incline_press.name: One-arm band incline press
single_arm_band_incline_press.cues: Band anchored low behind you, press one hand up and forward without twisting your trunk, then switch.

band_chest_press.name: Band chest press
band_chest_press.cues: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, step forward and press your hands straight out, then return.

seated_band_chest_press.name: Seated band chest press
seated_band_chest_press.cues: Sit tall, band wrapped around the chair back, and press both hands forward at chest height.

band_chest_fly.name: Band chest fly
band_chest_fly.cues: Band anchored behind you, arms softly bent, hug your hands together in front of your chest.

band_push_up.name: Band push-up
band_push_up.cues: Band across your upper back, ends under your hands; do a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.

band_close_grip_press.name: Band close-grip press
band_close_grip_press.cues: Band anchored behind you, hands close together and elbows tucked, press straight out and return slowly.

high_to_low_band_fly.name: High-to-low band fly
high_to_low_band_fly.cues: Anchor the band high, arms softly bent, and sweep your hands down and together toward your hips.

seated_high_to_low_band_fly.name: Seated high-to-low band fly
seated_high_to_low_band_fly.cues: Sit with the band anchored high behind you and sweep your hands down and together over your lap.

band_decline_press.name: Band decline press
band_decline_press.cues: Anchor the band high behind you and press your hands forward and down to belly height, then return.

seated_band_decline_press.name: Seated band decline press
seated_band_decline_press.cues: Sit tall with the band anchored high behind you and press down and forward toward your knees.

single_arm_high_to_low_band_fly.name: One-arm high-to-low band fly
single_arm_high_to_low_band_fly.cues: Band anchored high to one side, sweep that hand down across your body to the opposite hip, then switch.

band_lateral_raise.name: Band lateral raise
band_lateral_raise.cues: Stand on the band, elbows soft, and raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height, no higher.

seated_band_lateral_raise.name: Seated band lateral raise
seated_band_lateral_raise.cues: Sit on the band's middle or loop it under your feet and raise your arms out to shoulder height.

band_overhead_press.name: Band overhead press
band_overhead_press.cues: Stand or sit on the band, hands at shoulders, and press straight up without arching your lower back.

band_high_pull.name: Band high pull
band_high_pull.cues: Stand on the band, wide grip, and pull your elbows out and up only to chest height, then lower slowly.

band_reverse_fly.name: Band reverse fly
band_reverse_fly.cues: Hold the band anchored in front at chest height and open your arms wide, squeezing shoulder blades.

band_wide_row.name: Band wide row
band_wide_row.cues: Band anchored at chest height, pull with elbows wide and high until your hands reach your chest.

band_diagonal_pull_apart.name: Band diagonal pull-apart
band_diagonal_pull_apart.cues: Hold the band in front, then pull one hand up and out and the other down and out; alternate diagonals.

band_shrug.name: Band shrug
band_shrug.cues: Stand or sit on the band, arms straight, and lift your shoulders toward your ears, then lower slowly.

band_y_raise.name: Band Y raise
band_y_raise.cues: Stand on the band, thumbs up, and raise your arms forward and out into a Y, stopping before any pinch.

band_scapular_row.name: Band shoulder blade row
band_scapular_row.cues: Hold the band in front with straight arms and pull only by squeezing shoulder blades back, then release.

seated_band_row.name: Seated band row
seated_band_row.cues: Sit tall with the band around your feet and pull the handles to your ribs, shoulder blades together.

single_arm_band_row.name: One-arm band row
single_arm_band_row.cues: Band anchored in front, pull one elbow back past your ribs without twisting, then switch arms.

band_bent_over_row.name: Band bent-over row
band_bent_over_row.cues: Stand on the band, hinge forward with a flat back, and pull your hands toward your lower ribs.

band_lat_pulldown.name: Band lat pulldown
band_lat_pulldown.cues: Anchor the band high, sit or stand, and pull your elbows down to your sides toward your back pockets.

seated_band_pulldown.name: Seated band pulldown
seated_band_pulldown.cues: Sit tall, hold the band overhead with hands wide, and pull it apart and down behind your head to your neck.

band_straight_arm_pulldown.name: Band straight-arm pulldown
band_straight_arm_pulldown.cues: Band anchored high, arms straight, sweep your hands down to your thighs while ribs stay down.

band_hammer_curl.name: Band hammer curl
band_hammer_curl.cues: Stand on the band, palms facing each other, and curl up keeping elbows at your sides.

seated_band_curl.name: Seated band curl
seated_band_curl.cues: Sit tall with the band under your feet and curl your hands to your shoulders, elbows still.

band_concentration_curl.name: Band concentration curl
band_concentration_curl.cues: Sit, band under one foot, elbow resting inside that thigh, and curl slowly up and down; switch sides.

band_reverse_curl.name: Band reverse curl
band_reverse_curl.cues: Stand on the band, palms down, and curl up with straight wrists, keeping elbows by your sides.

band_overhead_triceps_extension.name: Band overhead triceps extension
band_overhead_triceps_extension.cues: Band under your back foot or chair, hands behind your head; straighten elbows upward, elbows near ears.

band_triceps_kickback.name: Band triceps kickback
band_triceps_kickback.cues: Lean forward slightly, elbow tucked at your side, and straighten your arm back against the band.

single_arm_band_pushdown.name: One-arm band pushdown
single_arm_band_pushdown.cues: Band anchored high, elbow pinned to your side, push your hand down until the arm is straight; switch.

band_wrist_extension.name: Band wrist extension
band_wrist_extension.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm down, band under your foot; lift the back of your hand slowly and lower.

band_wrist_curl.name: Band wrist curl
band_wrist_curl.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm up, band under your foot; curl your hand up slowly and lower.

band_wrist_rotation.name: Band wrist rotation
band_wrist_rotation.cues: Elbow bent at your side, hold the band anchored beside you and turn your palm up and down slowly.

incline_dumbbell_fly.name: Incline dumbbell fly
incline_dumbbell_fly.cues: On an incline bench, elbows softly bent, open your arms until you feel a stretch, then hug them up.

incline_dumbbell_squeeze_press.name: Incline squeeze press
incline_dumbbell_squeeze_press.cues: On an incline bench, press the dumbbells together over your chest and keep squeezing as you press up.

single_arm_incline_dumbbell_press.name: One-arm incline dumbbell press
single_arm_incline_dumbbell_press.cues: On an incline bench, press one dumbbell up while your body stays still, then switch arms.

reverse_grip_dumbbell_press.name: Reverse-grip dumbbell press
reverse_grip_dumbbell_press.cues: Lying on a bench, palms facing your face, press the dumbbells up over your chest with elbows tucked.

dumbbell_fly.name: Dumbbell fly
dumbbell_fly.cues: Lying on a bench, elbows softly bent, lower the dumbbells out wide to chest level and hug them back up.

dumbbell_squeeze_press.name: Dumbbell squeeze press
dumbbell_squeeze_press.cues: Lying on a bench, press the dumbbells firmly together and keep them touching as you press up.

dumbbell_floor_fly.name: Dumbbell floor fly
dumbbell_floor_fly.cues: Lie on the floor, elbows softly bent, lower the dumbbells until your upper arms touch down, then hug up.

bridge_floor_press.name: Bridge floor press
bridge_floor_press.cues: Lie on the floor, lift your hips into a bridge and press the dumbbells up over your lower chest.

single_arm_bridge_floor_press.name: One-arm bridge floor press
single_arm_bridge_floor_press.cues: Hold a hip bridge and press one dumbbell up over your lower chest without letting your hips tilt.

bridge_floor_squeeze_press.name: Bridge squeeze press
bridge_floor_squeeze_press.cues: Hold a hip bridge on the floor, press the dumbbells together and push them up over your lower chest.

decline_dumbbell_press.name: Decline dumbbell press
decline_dumbbell_press.cues: On a decline bench with feet secured, press the dumbbells up over your lower chest, then lower slowly.

dumbbell_pullover.name: Dumbbell pullover
dumbbell_pullover.cues: Lying on a bench, hold one dumbbell over your chest and lower it behind your head only as far as is comfortable.

dumbbell_lateral_raise.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
dumbbell_lateral_raise.cues: Elbows soft, raise the dumbbells out to your sides up to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

seated_dumbbell_lateral_raise.name: Seated lateral raise
seated_dumbbell_lateral_raise.cues: Sit tall on a chair, arms at your sides, and raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height.

leaning_lateral_raise.name: Supported leaning lateral raise
leaning_lateral_raise.cues: Hold a sturdy post with one hand, lean away slightly, and raise the dumbbell out to shoulder height.

dumbbell_front_raise.name: Dumbbell front raise
dumbbell_front_raise.cues: Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height with soft elbows, then lower with control.

seated_neutral_dumbbell_press.name: Seated neutral-grip press
seated_neutral_dumbbell_press.cues: Sit with back support, palms facing each other, and press the dumbbells up without arching your back.

dumbbell_high_pull.name: Dumbbell high pull
dumbbell_high_pull.cues: Pull the dumbbells up with elbows out, stopping at chest height so elbows never go above shoulders.

dumbbell_reverse_fly.name: Bent-over dumbbell reverse fly
dumbbell_reverse_fly.cues: Hinge forward with a flat back and raise light dumbbells out to the sides, squeezing shoulder blades.

chest_supported_reverse_fly.name: Chest-supported reverse fly
chest_supported_reverse_fly.cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and raise the dumbbells out to the sides without shrugging.

seated_reverse_fly.name: Seated bent-over reverse fly
seated_reverse_fly.cues: Sit at the chair edge, lean your chest toward your thighs, and raise the dumbbells out to the sides.

side_lying_rear_delt_raise.name: Side-lying rear delt raise
side_lying_rear_delt_raise.cues: Lie on your side, top arm straight in front, and lift the light dumbbell up toward the ceiling slowly.

dumbbell_rear_delt_row.name: Dumbbell rear delt row
dumbbell_rear_delt_row.cues: Chest on an incline bench, row the dumbbells up with elbows flared wide until they line up with shoulders.

dumbbell_farmer_hold.name: Dumbbell farmer hold
dumbbell_farmer_hold.cues: Stand tall holding heavy dumbbells at your sides, shoulders down, and breathe steadily for the hold.

dumbbell_farmer_walk.name: Dumbbell farmer walk
dumbbell_farmer_walk.cues: Hold dumbbells at your sides and walk slowly in a clear space, standing tall with shoulders down.

incline_prone_y_raise.name: Incline dumbbell Y raise
incline_prone_y_raise.cues: Chest-down on an incline bench, thumbs up, raise very light dumbbells into a Y without shrugging.

chest_supported_dumbbell_row.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
chest_supported_dumbbell_row.cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and row the dumbbells to your ribs, squeezing shoulder blades.

bent_over_dumbbell_row.name: Bent-over dumbbell row
bent_over_dumbbell_row.cues: Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft, and row both dumbbells to your lower ribs.

seated_dumbbell_row.name: Seated bent-over dumbbell row
seated_dumbbell_row.cues: Sit at the chair edge, lean forward with a long back, and row the dumbbells up beside your knees.

staggered_stance_dumbbell_row.name: Supported one-arm lat row
staggered_stance_dumbbell_row.cues: One hand on a sturdy chair, lean forward and pull the dumbbell back toward your hip, elbow close.

dumbbell_hammer_curl.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
dumbbell_hammer_curl.cues: Palms facing each other, curl the dumbbells up with elbows by your sides, then lower slowly.

dumbbell_concentration_curl.name: Concentration curl
dumbbell_concentration_curl.cues: Sit, elbow resting inside your thigh, and curl the dumbbell up slowly, then lower all the way.

incline_dumbbell_curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline_dumbbell_curl.cues: Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging, and curl up without letting elbows swing forward.

cross_body_hammer_curl.name: Cross-body hammer curl
cross_body_hammer_curl.cues: Palm facing in, curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder; alternate arms.

dumbbell_kickback.name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
dumbbell_kickback.cues: One hand on the bench, upper arm along your side, straighten the elbow back and squeeze.

seated_dumbbell_kickback.name: Seated triceps kickback
seated_dumbbell_kickback.cues: Sit at the chair edge leaning forward, elbows at your sides, and straighten both arms back.

lying_dumbbell_triceps_extension.name: Lying dumbbell triceps extension
lying_dumbbell_triceps_extension.cues: Lying on a bench, arms up, bend only the elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head, then extend.

close_grip_dumbbell_floor_press.name: Close-grip floor press
close_grip_dumbbell_floor_press.cues: Lie on the floor, dumbbells together, elbows tucked; press up and lower until the upper arms touch down.

dumbbell_wrist_extension.name: Dumbbell wrist extension
dumbbell_wrist_extension.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm down, lift a light dumbbell with the back of your hand, then lower.

dumbbell_reverse_curl.name: Dumbbell reverse curl
dumbbell_reverse_curl.cues: Palms down and wrists straight, curl the dumbbells up with elbows by your sides, then lower.

dumbbell_wrist_rotation.name: Dumbbell wrist rotation
dumbbell_wrist_rotation.cues: Forearm on your thigh, hold a light dumbbell at one end and slowly turn your palm up and down.

incline_machine_press.name: Incline machine press
incline_machine_press.cues: Set the seat so handles start at upper-chest height and press up and forward without locking elbows.

incline_barbell_bench_press.name: Incline barbell press
incline_barbell_bench_press.cues: With safety pins or a spotter, lower the bar to your upper chest and press it back up over your shoulders.

incline_cable_fly.name: Incline cable fly
incline_cable_fly.cues: On an incline bench between low pulleys, elbows soft, bring the handles up and together over your chest.

cable_incline_press.name: Standing cable incline press
cable_incline_press.cues: Pulleys set low behind you, staggered stance, press the handles up and forward to eye level.

barbell_bench_press.name: Barbell bench press
barbell_bench_press.cues: With safety pins or a spotter, lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows angled in and press back up.

machine_chest_fly.name: Machine chest fly
machine_chest_fly.cues: Sit tall with handles at chest height and bring them together in front of you, then open slowly.

cable_chest_fly.name: Cable chest fly
cable_chest_fly.cues: Pulleys at shoulder height, staggered stance, hug the handles together in front of your chest.

assisted_dip_machine.name: Assisted dip machine
assisted_dip_machine.cues: Kneel on the pad, lean slightly forward, and lower only until shoulders feel comfortable, then press up.

parallel_bar_dip.name: Parallel bar dip
parallel_bar_dip.cues: On a dip station, lean slightly forward and lower until elbows reach about 90 degrees, then press up.

decline_barbell_bench_press.name: Decline barbell press
decline_barbell_bench_press.cues: With a spotter, feet secured on the decline bench, lower the bar to your lower chest and press up.

single_arm_high_to_low_cable_fly.name: One-arm high-to-low cable fly
single_arm_high_to_low_cable_fly.cues: Pulley set high to one side, sweep the handle down across your body to the opposite hip; switch.

machine_shoulder_press.name: Machine shoulder press
machine_shoulder_press.cues: Back against the pad, press the handles overhead without locking elbows, then lower to shoulder level.

cable_lateral_raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cable_lateral_raise.cues: Low pulley at your side, raise the handle out across and up to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

machine_lateral_raise.name: Machine lateral raise
machine_lateral_raise.cues: Sit with arms against the pads and raise them out to shoulder height, then lower with control.

cable_front_raise.name: Cable front raise
cable_front_raise.cues: Facing away from a low pulley, raise the handle in front of you to shoulder height with soft elbows.

cable_high_pull.name: Cable high pull
cable_high_pull.cues: Wide grip on a bar at a low pulley, pull elbows out and up only to chest height, then lower slowly.

machine_reverse_fly.name: Machine reverse fly
machine_reverse_fly.cues: Sit facing the pad, arms straight at shoulder height, and open them wide squeezing shoulder blades.

cable_face_pull.name: Cable face pull
cable_face_pull.cues: Rope at face height, pull it toward your eyes with elbows high, turning your hands back at the end.

cable_reverse_fly.name: Cable reverse fly
cable_reverse_fly.cues: Cross the cables from two high-ish pulleys and open your arms wide at shoulder height, then return.

single_arm_cable_reverse_fly.name: One-arm cable reverse fly
single_arm_cable_reverse_fly.cues: Pulley at shoulder height, grab it with the far hand and sweep your arm out wide; switch sides.

wide_grip_cable_row.name: Wide-grip cable row
wide_grip_cable_row.cues: Sit tall, wide grip on the bar, and row to your chest with elbows high and out, then release slowly.

cable_shrug.name: Cable shrug
cable_shrug.cues: Hold the bar from a low pulley, arms straight, and lift your shoulders to your ears, then lower.

barbell_shrug.name: Barbell shrug
barbell_shrug.cues: Hold the bar in front of your thighs, stand tall, and lift your shoulders straight up without rolling.

cable_y_raise.name: Cable Y raise
cable_y_raise.cues: Cross two low cables and raise your arms up and out into a Y, thumbs up, stopping before any pinch.

machine_row.name: Chest-supported machine row
machine_row.cues: Chest against the pad, pull the handles to your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

barbell_bent_over_row.name: Barbell bent-over row
barbell_bent_over_row.cues: Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees, and row the bar to your lower ribs without jerking.

single_arm_cable_row.name: One-arm cable row
single_arm_cable_row.cues: Pulley at chest height, pull one handle back to your ribs without twisting, then switch arms.

inverted_bar_row.name: Inverted bar row
inverted_bar_row.cues: Set a bar in a rack at waist height, hang under it with a straight body, and pull your chest to the bar.

pull_up.name: Pull-up
pull_up.cues: Hang with hands shoulder-width, palms away, and pull your chest toward the bar, then lower fully.

chin_up.name: Chin-up
chin_up.cues: Hang with palms facing you and pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control.

assisted_pull_up_machine.name: Assisted pull-up machine
assisted_pull_up_machine.cues: Kneel on the pad, grip the handles, and pull your chest up toward them, then lower slowly.

straight_arm_cable_pulldown.name: Straight-arm cable pulldown
straight_arm_cable_pulldown.cues: Facing a high pulley, arms straight, sweep the bar down to your thighs while keeping ribs down.

single_arm_cable_pulldown.name: One-arm cable pulldown
single_arm_cable_pulldown.cues: Seated or kneeling below a high pulley, pull one elbow down toward your hip, then reach up; switch.

cable_curl.name: Cable curl
cable_curl.cues: Facing a low pulley, elbows at your sides, curl the bar up to your chest and lower slowly.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell curl
barbell_curl.cues: Stand tall, palms up, and curl the bar up without leaning back, keeping elbows at your sides.

machine_preacher_curl.name: Machine preacher curl
machine_preacher_curl.cues: Upper arms on the pad, curl the handles up, then lower slowly, stopping just short of locking out.

cable_hammer_curl.name: Cable rope hammer curl
cable_hammer_curl.cues: Rope on a low pulley, palms facing each other, curl up with elbows at your sides and lower slowly.

cable_rope_pushdown.name: Cable rope pushdown
cable_rope_pushdown.cues: Elbows pinned to your sides, push the rope down and spread the ends at the bottom, then return.

overhead_cable_triceps_extension.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
overhead_cable_triceps_extension.cues: Facing away from the pulley, rope behind your head, straighten your elbows forward and up.

close_grip_bench_press.name: Close-grip bench press
close_grip_bench_press.cues: With a spotter, hands shoulder-width, lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows tucked and press.

cable_kickback.name: Cable triceps kickback
cable_kickback.cues: Hinge slightly, upper arm along your side, and straighten your elbow back against the low cable.

cable_reverse_curl.name: Cable reverse curl
cable_reverse_curl.cues: Palms down on a low-pulley bar, wrists straight, curl up with elbows at your sides and lower slowly.

barbell_reverse_curl.name: Barbell reverse curl
barbell_reverse_curl.cues: Palms down on the bar, wrists straight, curl up with elbows at your sides, then lower slowly.

barbell_wrist_curl.name: Seated barbell wrist curl
barbell_wrist_curl.cues: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms up, and curl a light bar up with your wrists only.

dead_hang.name: Dead hang
dead_hang.cues: Grip the bar and hang with feet just off a step, shoulders gently engaged; step down before grip fails.

single_leg_glute_bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single_leg_glute_bridge.cues: Lie on your back, one foot planted, other leg up; lift hips level without arching.

heel_dig_bridge.name: Heel-dig bridge
heel_dig_bridge.cues: Feet farther out, toes up; dig heels down and lift hips a little, then lower slowly.

clamshell.name: Side-lying clamshell
clamshell.cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together; open the top knee without rolling back.

side_lying_leg_raise.name: Side-lying leg raise
side_lying_leg_raise.cues: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent; lift the straight top leg slightly back, then lower slowly.

supported_hip_abduction.name: Supported side leg raise
supported_hip_abduction.cues: Hold a chair, stand tall; lift one leg out to the side, toes forward, and lower with control.

supported_hip_extension.name: Supported leg kickback
supported_hip_extension.cues: Hold a chair; move one straight leg back a little, squeeze your glute, keep your back still.

supported_hamstring_curl.name: Supported hamstring curl
supported_hamstring_curl.cues: Hold a chair, knees side by side; bend one knee to bring the heel up, then lower slowly.

supported_single_leg_rdl.name: Supported single-leg hinge
supported_single_leg_rdl.cues: Hold a chair, soft knee; hinge forward as the free leg goes back, back flat, then stand up.

bodyweight_good_morning.name: Bodyweight good morning
bodyweight_good_morning.cues: Hands on chest, soft knees; push hips back with a flat back until you feel a stretch, then stand.

chair_supported_squat.name: Chair-supported squat
chair_supported_squat.cues: Hold a chair back; sit hips back and down only as far as comfortable, then push up tall.

supported_split_squat.name: Supported split squat
supported_split_squat.cues: Hold a chair, one foot forward and one back; lower straight down a little, then rise.

partial_wall_sit.name: Partial wall sit
partial_wall_sit.cues: Back on a wall, slide down a little, knees over ankles; hold and keep breathing.

low_step_up.name: Low step-up
low_step_up.cues: Hold a rail, step onto a low stair with the whole foot, stand tall, step down with control.

sumo_squat.name: Sumo squat
sumo_squat.cues: Wide stance, toes slightly out; sit down with knees tracking over toes, then stand up.

seated_pillow_squeeze.name: Seated pillow squeeze
seated_pillow_squeeze.cues: Sit tall with a pillow or ball between your knees; squeeze for a few seconds, then relax.

bridge_pillow_squeeze.name: Bridge with pillow squeeze
bridge_pillow_squeeze.cues: Pillow between knees; breathe out as you squeeze and lift your hips a little, breathe in as you lower slowly. Never hold your breath.

short_lever_copenhagen.name: Short Copenhagen plank
short_lever_copenhagen.cues: Side plank on your elbow, top knee on a chair seat; lift your hips in line and hold.

seated_knee_extension.name: Seated knee extension
seated_knee_extension.cues: Sit tall, hold the seat; straighten one knee, pause, then lower slowly.

seated_march_hold.name: Seated march with hold
seated_march_hold.cues: Sit tall without leaning back; lift one knee, hold 3 seconds, lower, switch sides.

straight_leg_raise.name: Straight-leg raise
straight_leg_raise.cues: Lie on your back, one knee bent; tighten the other thigh and lift the straight leg to knee height.

short_arc_quad.name: Short-arc knee straighten
short_arc_quad.cues: Lie back with a rolled towel under one knee; straighten the knee to lift the heel, hold, lower.

door_frame_squat_hold.name: Door-frame squat hold
door_frame_squat_hold.cues: Hold a door frame, lean back with arms straight, shins upright; sit into a small squat and hold.

partial_sit_to_stand.name: High-chair sit-to-stand
partial_sit_to_stand.cues: From a high seat, hands on armrests if needed; lean forward, stand up, then sit down slowly.

supported_single_leg_calf_raise.name: Supported single-leg calf raise
supported_single_leg_calf_raise.cues: Hold a counter, stand on one foot; rise onto the ball of the foot, then lower slowly.

seated_heel_raise.name: Seated heel raise
seated_heel_raise.cues: Sit tall, feet flat; lift both heels as high as you can, pause, lower slowly.

seated_toe_raise.name: Seated toe raise
seated_toe_raise.cues: Sit tall, heels on the floor; lift your toes and forefoot up, pause, lower slowly.

seated_heel_toe_rock.name: Seated heel-toe rock
seated_heel_toe_rock.cues: Sit tall, feet flat; rock up onto your toes, then back onto your heels, slow and steady.

supported_toe_raise.name: Supported toe raise
supported_toe_raise.cues: Hold a counter, stand tall; lift your toes off the floor without leaning back, then lower.

heel_walk.name: Heel walk
heel_walk.cues: Lift your toes and walk slowly on your heels, standing tall, near a wall for safety.

seated_crunch_brace.name: Seated crunch
seated_crunch_brace.cues: Sit near the front of a chair; brace, curl your ribs toward your hips a little, then sit tall.

seated_side_bend.name: Seated side bend
seated_side_bend.cues: Sit tall, hands by your sides; slide one hand toward the floor, then pull yourself upright.

seated_lean_back_hold.name: Seated lean-back hold
seated_lean_back_hold.cues: Sit near the front of a chair, arms crossed; lean back a little with a long spine and hold.

standing_oblique_crunch.name: Standing side crunch
standing_oblique_crunch.cues: Hold a chair with one hand; lift the outside knee as the same elbow comes down to meet it.

standing_supported_bird_dog.name: Standing bird dog
standing_supported_bird_dog.cues: One hand on a wall; reach the other arm forward as the opposite leg goes back, hold, switch.

incline_plank.name: Incline plank
incline_plank.cues: Hands on a counter or sturdy table, body in a straight line; brace and hold, breathing.

dead_bug_heel_tap.name: Dead bug heel tap
dead_bug_heel_tap.cues: On your back, knees up at 90 degrees, back flat; lower one heel to tap the floor, return, switch.

kneeling_side_plank.name: Kneeling side plank
kneeling_side_plank.cues: On your side, elbow under shoulder, knees bent; lift hips in line with your body and hold.

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle_crunch.cues: On your back, hands by ears; bring one elbow toward the opposite knee slowly, without pulling your neck.

prone_back_extension.name: Prone back extension
prone_back_extension.cues: Lie face down, hands by your hips; lift your chest a little, eyes down, then lower slowly.

band_seated_leg_extension.name: Band seated leg extension
band_seated_leg_extension.cues: Band around a chair leg and your ankle; straighten the knee against it, then bend slowly.

band_seated_leg_press.name: Band seated leg press
band_seated_leg_press.cues: Sit tall, band under one foot, ends in hands; push the foot forward until the leg is straight, return.

band_seated_hip_abduction.name: Band seated hip abduction
band_seated_hip_abduction.cues: Sit tall, band above your knees; press knees apart, pause, then bring them back slowly.

band_seated_trunk_rotation.name: Band seated trunk rotation
band_seated_trunk_rotation.cues: Band anchored to one side at chest height; sit tall and turn your chest away a little, return slowly.

band_seated_hamstring_curl.name: Band seated hamstring curl
band_seated_hamstring_curl.cues: Band anchored in front around your ankle; pull the heel back under the chair, then return slowly.

band_seated_calf_press.name: Band seated calf press
band_seated_calf_press.cues: Sit with one leg straight, band around the ball of the foot; point your toes, then return slowly.

band_seated_dorsiflexion.name: Band seated toe pull
band_seated_dorsiflexion.cues: Band anchored in front over your forefoot; pull your toes toward you, then return slowly.

band_glute_bridge.name: Band glute bridge
band_glute_bridge.cues: Band above your knees; push knees out gently and lift hips, squeeze, then lower slowly.

band_lateral_walk.name: Band side step
band_lateral_walk.cues: Band above your knees, slight squat; step sideways along a counter, keeping tension, then return.

band_standing_kickback.name: Band standing kickback
band_standing_kickback.cues: Band around both ankles, hold a chair; press one leg back a little without arching, return slowly.

band_good_morning.name: Band good morning
band_good_morning.cues: Band under feet and behind your neck base; hinge at hips with a flat back, then stand tall.

band_squat.name: Band squat
band_squat.cues: Stand on the band, hands at shoulders; sit down as far as comfortable, then push up tall.

band_woodchop.name: Band woodchop
band_woodchop.cues: Band anchored high to one side; pull diagonally down across your body, turning from the trunk.

band_dead_bug.name: Band dead bug
band_dead_bug.cues: Band anchored behind your head, arms straight; keep it tight and lower one leg at a time, back flat.

band_standing_hip_adduction.name: Band standing hip adduction
band_standing_hip_adduction.cues: Band anchored to one side at ankle height; hold a chair and pull the leg across your body, return.

dumbbell_split_squat.name: Dumbbell split squat
dumbbell_split_squat.cues: Dumbbells at your sides, one foot forward; lower straight down with a tall chest, then rise.

dumbbell_box_squat.name: Dumbbell box squat
dumbbell_box_squat.cues: Hold a dumbbell at your chest; sit back to lightly touch the bench, then stand up tall.

dumbbell_hip_thrust.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
dumbbell_hip_thrust.cues: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on hips; drive hips up until level, chin tucked, lower slowly.

dumbbell_sumo_squat.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
dumbbell_sumo_squat.cues: Wide stance, one dumbbell hanging between your legs; sit down with knees out, then stand.

dumbbell_single_leg_rdl.name: Dumbbell single-leg deadlift
dumbbell_single_leg_rdl.cues: Dumbbell in one hand, other hand on a wall; hinge on one leg with a flat back, then stand up.

dumbbell_seated_calf_raise.name: Dumbbell seated calf raise
dumbbell_seated_calf_raise.cues: Sit tall, dumbbells resting on your thighs near the knees; lift your heels high, lower slowly.

dumbbell_suitcase_carry.name: Suitcase carry
dumbbell_suitcase_carry.cues: Hold one dumbbell at your side and walk slowly, standing tall without leaning; switch hands.

dumbbell_dead_bug.name: Dumbbell dead bug
dumbbell_dead_bug.cues: On your back, hold a light dumbbell above your chest; lower one leg at a time, back flat.

machine_leg_extension.name: Machine leg extension
machine_leg_extension.cues: Pad on your lower shins, back against the seat; straighten your knees smoothly, lower slowly.

seated_leg_curl_machine.name: Seated leg curl
seated_leg_curl_machine.cues: Pad above your heels, thigh pad snug; bend your knees to pull the pad down, return slowly.

hip_abduction_machine.name: Hip abduction machine
hip_abduction_machine.cues: Sit tall, pads outside your knees; press your legs apart, pause, then close slowly.

hip_adduction_machine.name: Hip adduction machine
hip_adduction_machine.cues: Sit tall, pads inside your knees; squeeze your legs together, then open slowly to a comfy width.

barbell_back_squat.name: Barbell back squat
barbell_back_squat.cues: Bar on upper back in a rack with safeties; brace, sit down to a depth you control, drive up.

barbell_hip_thrust.name: Barbell hip thrust
barbell_hip_thrust.cues: Upper back on a bench, padded bar on hips; drive hips up until level, pause, lower slowly.

cable_pull_through.name: Cable pull-through
cable_pull_through.cues: Face away from a low cable, rope between legs; hinge back, then drive hips forward to stand.

seated_calf_raise_machine.name: Seated calf raise machine
seated_calf_raise_machine.cues: Pad on your thighs, balls of feet on the step; lift heels high, lower slowly to a gentle stretch.

cable_woodchop.name: Cable woodchop
cable_woodchop.cues: Cable set high, feet wide; pull the handle down across your body, turning chest and hips together.

cable_kneeling_crunch.name: Cable kneeling crunch
cable_kneeling_crunch.cues: Kneel facing a high cable, rope by your head; curl ribs toward hips without sitting back, return.

back_extension_bench.name: 45-degree back extension
back_extension_bench.cues: Hips on the pad, arms crossed; lower with a long spine, then rise until your body is in line.

cable_terminal_knee_extension.name: Cable terminal knee extension
cable_terminal_knee_extension.cues: Strap behind one knee, facing a low cable; start slightly bent, then press the knee fully straight.

machine_ab_crunch.name: Machine ab crunch
machine_ab_crunch.cues: Sit tall, set a light weight; curl your chest toward your hips with your abs, return slowly.

cable_pallof_press.name: Cable Pallof press
cable_pallof_press.cues: Stand side-on to a chest-high cable; press the handle straight out without turning, hold, return.

wu_seated_shoulder_rolls.name: Seated shoulder rolls
wu_seated_shoulder_rolls.cues: Sit tall and roll your shoulders up, back and down in slow circles.

wu_seated_reach_ups.name: Seated reach-ups
wu_seated_reach_ups.cues: Sit tall and reach one arm, then the other, up toward the ceiling without shrugging.

wu_seated_punches.name: Seated forward punches
wu_seated_punches.cues: Sit tall and punch forward one arm at a time at an easy pace, keeping elbows soft.

wu_seated_wrist_circles.name: Seated wrist circles
wu_seated_wrist_circles.cues: Hold your arms in front and circle your wrists slowly both ways, then open and close your hands.

wu_seated_elbow_openers.name: Seated elbow openers
wu_seated_elbow_openers.cues: With fingertips on your shoulders, bring elbows together in front, then open them wide.

wu_seated_side_bends.name: Seated side bends
wu_seated_side_bends.cues: Sit tall with feet flat and slide one hand toward the floor, then the other, in a slow rhythm.

wu_seated_march_arm_swing.name: Seated march with arm swing
wu_seated_march_arm_swing.cues: Sit tall, lift your knees in turn and swing your arms as if walking, at a comfortable pace.

wu_seated_ankle_circles.name: Seated ankle circles
wu_seated_ankle_circles.cues: Lift one foot slightly and draw slow circles with your toes both ways, then switch feet.

wu_seated_knee_extensions.name: Seated leg kicks
wu_seated_knee_extensions.cues: Sit tall and slowly straighten one knee, then lower it; alternate legs with control.

wu_seated_heel_toe_taps.name: Seated heel-toe taps
wu_seated_heel_toe_taps.cues: Keep your feet on the floor and rock from heels to toes at an easy, steady rhythm.

wu_wall_slides.name: Wall slides
wu_wall_slides.cues: Stand with your back and forearms on a wall and slide your arms up and down slowly without pain.

wu_arm_hug_swings.name: Open-and-hug arm swings
wu_arm_hug_swings.cues: Swing your arms wide open, then across your chest in a gentle hug, at a relaxed pace.

wu_standing_t_rotations.name: Standing T rotations
wu_standing_t_rotations.cues: Stand with arms out in a T and turn your upper body side to side, letting your gaze follow a hand.

wu_lateral_leg_swings.name: Side-to-side leg swings
wu_lateral_leg_swings.cues: Hold a wall or chair and swing one leg gently across your body and out to the side.

wu_hip_gate_openers.name: Hip gate openers
wu_hip_gate_openers.cues: Lift one knee in front, turn it out to the side and lower it; hold support if you need it.

wu_ankle_rocks.name: Knee-to-wall ankle rocks
wu_ankle_rocks.cues: Face a wall with one foot forward and gently drive the knee toward the wall, keeping the heel down.

wu_heel_toe_rocks.name: Standing heel-toe rocks
wu_heel_toe_rocks.cues: Hold support and rock slowly up onto your toes, then back onto your heels.

wu_mini_squats.name: Warm-up mini squats
wu_mini_squats.cues: Hold support, bend your knees a little and stand back up in an easy, smooth rhythm.

wu_step_touch.name: Step touch
wu_step_touch.cues: Step to the side, bring the other foot in to tap, and repeat side to side with relaxed arms.

wu_step_jacks.name: Low-impact step jacks
wu_step_jacks.cues: Step one foot out as your arms rise, step back in, then switch sides; no jumping.

wu_march_overhead_reach.name: March with overhead reach
wu_march_overhead_reach.cues: March in place and reach both arms up on every fourth step, breathing easily.

wu_side_step_reach.name: Side step with reach
wu_side_step_reach.cues: Step wide to one side and reach the opposite arm over your head, then switch sides.

wu_inchworm_lite.name: Inchworm lite
wu_inchworm_lite.cues: Bend your knees, walk your hands out to a high plank, walk them back and roll up slowly.

kid_bear_crawl.name: Animal walk: bear crawl
kid_bear_crawl.cues: On hands and feet with hips up, walk like a bear slowly; keep fingers spread and stop if wrists hurt.

kid_crab_walk.name: Animal walk: crab walk
kid_crab_walk.cues: Sit, place hands behind you, lift your hips and walk like a crab; go slow and stop if wrists hurt.

kid_frog_hops.name: Little frog hops
kid_frog_hops.cues: Squat like a frog, hop forward just a little and land softly on bent knees; tiny hops only.

kid_statue_freeze.name: Statue freeze
kid_statue_freeze.cues: Walk around, then on 'freeze' stop and hold a statue pose on one foot; touch a wall if you wobble.

kid_soft_star_jumps.name: Soft star jumps
kid_soft_star_jumps.cues: Jump up into a big star shape and land softly on bent knees; rest between jumps.

kid_reach_for_the_stars.name: Reach for the stars
kid_reach_for_the_stars.cues: Stretch up tall on your toes and reach for the stars, then crouch softly to pick them up.

kid_penguin_march.name: Penguin march
kid_penguin_march.cues: Keep arms at your sides like flippers and march in place, lifting knees high like a happy penguin.

st_seated_chest_opener.name: Seated chest opener
st_seated_chest_opener.cues: Sit tall, hold the sides of the chair seat behind your hips and gently lift your chest.

st_clasped_hands_chest_opener.name: Clasped-hands chest stretch
st_clasped_hands_chest_opener.cues: Clasp your hands behind your back, straighten your arms gently and lift your chest.

st_wall_front_shoulder_stretch.name: Wall front shoulder stretch
st_wall_front_shoulder_stretch.cues: Place your palm on a wall behind you at shoulder height and turn your body away slowly.

st_thread_the_needle.name: Thread the needle
st_thread_the_needle.cues: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your body, resting shoulder and cheek down, and breathe.

st_wall_lat_stretch.name: Wall lat stretch
st_wall_lat_stretch.cues: Put your hands on a wall, step back and hinge at the hips until you feel a stretch along your sides.

st_seated_forward_reach.name: Seated upper-back reach
st_seated_forward_reach.cues: Sit tall, clasp your hands in front at chest height and round your upper back as you push them away.

st_seated_neck_stretch.name: Seated neck stretch
st_seated_neck_stretch.cues: Sit tall, hold the chair with one hand and tilt your head gently to the other side; no pulling.

st_neck_diagonal_stretch.name: Diagonal neck stretch
st_neck_diagonal_stretch.cues: Turn your head slightly to one side and lower your chin toward that armpit; breathe and relax.

st_table_biceps_stretch.name: Table biceps stretch
st_table_biceps_stretch.cues: Stand with your back to a table, rest your palms on it with arms straight and bend your knees slightly.

st_arm_out_biceps_stretch.name: Arm-out biceps stretch
st_arm_out_biceps_stretch.cues: Hold one arm out to the side, thumb pointing down, and gently move it back until you feel a stretch.

st_wall_triceps_stretch.name: Wall triceps stretch
st_wall_triceps_stretch.cues: Bend one elbow overhead, rest it on a wall and lean in gently until the back of the arm stretches.

st_bent_arm_cross_triceps.name: Bent-arm cross-body stretch
st_bent_arm_cross_triceps.cues: Bend one elbow, hand toward the opposite shoulder, and gently press the elbow across with your other hand.

st_wrist_flexor_stretch.name: Wrist flexor stretch
st_wrist_flexor_stretch.cues: Hold one arm out, palm up, and gently pull the fingers down and back with your other hand.

st_wrist_extensor_stretch.name: Wrist extensor stretch
st_wrist_extensor_stretch.cues: Hold one arm out, palm down, and gently bend the hand down with your other hand.

st_prayer_stretch.name: Prayer wrist stretch
st_prayer_stretch.cues: Press your palms together in front of your chest and slowly lower them until the wrists stretch.

st_seated_side_reach.name: Seated side reach
st_seated_side_reach.cues: Sit tall, hold the chair with one hand and reach the other arm up and over to the side.

st_seated_twist_stretch.name: Seated twist stretch
st_seated_twist_stretch.cues: Sit tall, place one hand on the opposite knee and turn gently to look behind you; keep hips facing forward.

st_cobra_stretch.name: Gentle cobra stretch
st_cobra_stretch.cues: Lie face down, place hands under your shoulders and lift your chest only as high as feels easy.

st_knees_to_chest.name: Knees-to-chest stretch
st_knees_to_chest.cues: Lie on your back, hug both knees toward your chest and rock gently side to side.

st_seated_forward_fold.name: Seated forward fold
st_seated_forward_fold.cues: Sit with feet wide and let your chest lower slowly toward your thighs, hands sliding down your legs.

st_supine_twist.name: Lying knee drop twist
st_supine_twist.cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and let them fall slowly to one side, shoulders staying down.

st_supine_figure_four.name: Lying figure-four stretch
st_supine_figure_four.cues: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the other knee and gently draw the legs toward you.

st_standing_figure_four.name: Supported standing figure-four
st_standing_figure_four.cues: Hold a chair, cross one ankle over the other knee and sit back a little until the hip stretches.

st_standing_hip_flexor_stretch.name: Standing hip flexor stretch
st_standing_hip_flexor_stretch.cues: Hold support, step one foot back, tuck your tailbone and shift forward until the front of the hip stretches.

st_seated_hip_flexor_stretch.name: Seated hip flexor stretch
st_seated_hip_flexor_stretch.cues: Sit sideways on a sturdy chair edge, slide the outside leg back with toes down and sit tall.

st_butterfly_stretch.name: Butterfly stretch
st_butterfly_stretch.cues: Sit on the floor, bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees drop gently outward.

st_side_lunge_stretch.name: Side lunge stretch
st_side_lunge_stretch.cues: Stand wide, bend one knee and shift your hips toward it, keeping the other leg straight.

st_seated_wide_leg_stretch.name: Seated wide-leg stretch
st_seated_wide_leg_stretch.cues: Sit on a chair with knees wide, hands on inner thighs, and lean forward gently with a long back.

st_side_lying_quad_stretch.name: Side-lying quad stretch
st_side_lying_quad_stretch.cues: Lie on your side, hold your top ankle and draw the heel toward your seat, knees together.

st_prone_quad_stretch.name: Face-down quad stretch
st_prone_quad_stretch.cues: Lie face down, bend one knee and hold the ankle, easing the heel toward your seat without pain.

st_standing_hamstring_stretch.name: Heel-on-step hamstring stretch
st_standing_hamstring_stretch.cues: Hold support, rest one heel on a low step with the knee soft and hinge forward with a long back.

st_supine_hamstring_stretch.name: Lying hamstring stretch
st_supine_hamstring_stretch.cues: Lie on your back, hold behind one thigh and straighten the knee toward the ceiling as far as is easy.

st_step_calf_stretch.name: Step calf stretch
st_step_calf_stretch.cues: Hold a rail, stand with the ball of one foot on a step and let the heel sink slowly below it.

st_seated_calf_stretch.name: Seated calf stretch
st_seated_calf_stretch.cues: Sit near the chair edge, straighten one leg with the heel down and pull your toes back toward you.

st_kneeling_shin_stretch.name: Kneeling shin stretch
st_kneeling_shin_stretch.cues: Kneel on a mat with the tops of your feet flat and sit back gently toward your heels.

st_standing_shin_stretch.name: Standing shin stretch
st_standing_shin_stretch.cues: Hold support, place the top of one foot on the floor behind you and gently press the ankle forward.

st_seated_shin_stretch.name: Seated shin stretch
st_seated_shin_stretch.cues: Sit near the chair edge, tuck one foot back under the seat with the top of the toes on the floor.

bal_seated_weight_shifts.name: Seated weight shifts
bal_seated_weight_shifts.cues: Sit tall without leaning back and shift your weight slowly to one hip, then the other.

bal_seated_reach_outs.name: Seated reach-outs
bal_seated_reach_outs.cues: Sit tall with feet flat and reach forward and to the sides as far as you can stay steady.

bal_seated_trunk_control.name: Seated trunk control
bal_seated_trunk_control.cues: Sit away from the backrest, cross your arms and lift one foot slightly; hold steady, then switch.

bal_chair_single_leg_hold.name: Chair-supported knee lift hold
bal_chair_single_leg_hold.cues: Hold the back of a chair with both hands, lift one knee a little and hold, standing tall.

bal_supported_tandem_stance.name: Supported tandem stance
bal_supported_tandem_stance.cues: Hold a counter and stand with one foot directly in front of the other, heel to toe; hold, then switch.

bal_supported_heel_toe_walk.name: Supported heel-to-toe walk
bal_supported_heel_toe_walk.cues: With one hand on a counter or wall, walk slowly placing each heel right in front of the other toes.

bal_supported_side_steps.name: Supported side steps
bal_supported_side_steps.cues: Face a counter with hands on it and take slow side steps, toes forward, then come back.

bal_sit_to_stand_hold.name: Sit-to-stand balance hold
bal_sit_to_stand_hold.cues: Stand up from a chair using the armrests if needed, pause tall for three breaths, then sit slowly.

bal_supported_clock_reach.name: Supported clock reach
bal_supported_clock_reach.cues: Hold a chair with one hand, stand on the near leg and point the other foot to 12, 3 and 6 o'clock.

bal_tandem_stance.name: Tandem stance
bal_tandem_stance.cues: Stand near a wall with one foot right in front of the other, heel to toe, and hold without touching.

bal_single_leg_reach.name: Single-leg forward reach
bal_single_leg_reach.cues: Stand on one leg, knee soft, and hinge to reach forward with your hands, then return tall.

rx_iso_er_45_doorframe.name: Door-frame ER hold at 45°
rx_iso_er_45_doorframe.cues: Arm out 45°, elbow bent, press the back of your hand gently into a door frame and hold without pain.

rx_iso_ir_45_doorframe.name: Door-frame IR hold at 45°
rx_iso_ir_45_doorframe.cues: Arm out 45°, elbow bent, press your palm gently into a door frame as if turning inward, and hold.

rx_iso_er_90_wall.name: Wall ER hold at 90°
rx_iso_er_90_wall.cues: Elbow at shoulder height against a wall, forearm up, press the back of the hand lightly into the wall and hold.

rx_iso_shoulder_extension_wall.name: Wall shoulder extension hold
rx_iso_shoulder_extension_wall.cues: Back to a wall, arm straight at your side, press the back of the arm gently into the wall and hold.

rx_hand_behind_back_press.name: Hand-behind-back press
rx_hand_behind_back_press.cues: Rest the back of your hand on your lower back only as far as comfortable, press it gently away and hold.

rx_prone_arm_lift_hold.name: Face-down arm lift hold
rx_prone_arm_lift_hold.cues: Lie face down, arms by your sides, lift the hands a little off the floor, squeeze the shoulder blades and hold.

rx_iso_overhead_wall_press.name: Wall overhead press hold
rx_iso_overhead_wall_press.cues: Face a wall, hands on it as high as is pain-free, press gently into the wall and hold with ribs down.

rx_wall_y_hold.name: Wall Y lift-off hold
rx_wall_y_hold.cues: Face a wall, arms in a Y as high as comfortable, lift the hands just off the wall and hold.

rx_scapular_setting_hold.name: Shoulder blade setting hold
rx_scapular_setting_hold.cues: Sit or stand tall, draw the shoulder blades gently back and down, hold without shrugging.

rx_band_row_hold.name: Band row hold
rx_band_row_hold.cues: Pull a light band to your ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades and hold with the neck relaxed.

rx_wall_push_hold.name: Wall push-up hold
rx_wall_push_hold.cues: Hands on a wall at chest height, lean in to a comfortable bend and hold with a straight body.

rx_suitcase_hold.name: Suitcase hold
rx_suitcase_hold.cues: Hold one dumbbell at your side, stand tall without leaning, shoulders level, and breathe.

rx_front_rack_hold.name: Goblet carry hold
rx_front_rack_hold.cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, elbows in, stand tall and breathe steadily.

rx_waiter_hold.name: Overhead waiter hold
rx_waiter_hold.cues: Hold a light dumbbell overhead with a straight arm, ribs down, only if pain-free, and hold.

rx_band_er_45.name: Band ER at 45°
rx_band_er_45.cues: Arm out 45°, elbow bent, rotate the forearm back against a light band only in the pain-free range.

rx_band_internal_rotation.name: Band internal rotation
rx_band_internal_rotation.cues: Elbow at your side, towel under the arm, turn the forearm in against a light band, pain-free range only.

rx_side_lying_er.name: Side-lying external rotation
rx_side_lying_er.cues: Lie on your side, elbow on your hip with a towel, lift a very light weight up slowly, pain-free range.

rx_wall_slide_partial.name: Partial wall slide
rx_wall_slide_partial.cues: Forearms on a wall, slide them up only as far as pain-free, then lower slowly.

rx_wall_push_up_plus.name: Wall push-up plus
rx_wall_push_up_plus.cues: Hands on a wall, arms straight, let the shoulder blades come together, then push the wall away a bit more.

rx_dumbbell_scaption.name: Dumbbell scaption raise
rx_dumbbell_scaption.cues: Thumbs up, raise light dumbbells in a slight V to shoulder height or less, lower slowly.

rx_iso_curl_hold.name: Isometric curl hold
rx_iso_curl_hold.cues: Elbow bent at 90°, press your palm up under a table or into your other hand and hold gently.

rx_iso_triceps_press_hold.name: Isometric triceps press
rx_iso_triceps_press_hold.cues: Elbow bent at 90°, press the side of your fist down into a table and hold without pain.

rx_chair_press_hold.name: Seated chair press hold
rx_chair_press_hold.cues: Sit on a sturdy chair, hands on the armrests, press down to unload the seat a little and hold.

rx_band_curl_partial.name: Partial band curl
rx_band_curl_partial.cues: Stand on a light band and curl only through the pain-free part of the movement, lower slowly.

rx_band_triceps_kickback_partial.name: Partial band kickback
rx_band_triceps_kickback_partial.cues: Hinge slightly, elbow by your side, straighten the arm back against a light band in the pain-free range.

rx_iso_wrist_flexion.name: Isometric wrist flexion
rx_iso_wrist_flexion.cues: Forearm on a table, palm up, press the palm up into your other hand and hold without moving.

rx_iso_wrist_flexion_table.name: Under-table palm lift hold
rx_iso_wrist_flexion_table.cues: Sit at a table, fingers and palm under the edge, gently lift up with the wrist and hold.

rx_dumbbell_wrist_hold.name: Palm-up dumbbell hold
rx_dumbbell_wrist_hold.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm up, hold a light dumbbell with the wrist level and still.

rx_towel_grip_squeeze.name: Towel grip squeeze
rx_towel_grip_squeeze.cues: Roll up a towel, squeeze it gently with your whole hand and hold, then relax.

rx_iso_forearm_supination.name: Isometric palm-up turn
rx_iso_forearm_supination.cues: Elbow bent at your side, try to turn the palm up while your other hand stops it; hold gently.

rx_iso_forearm_pronation.name: Isometric palm-down turn
rx_iso_forearm_pronation.cues: Elbow bent at your side, try to turn the palm down while your other hand stops it; hold gently.

rx_dumbbell_end_hold.name: Upright dumbbell end hold
rx_dumbbell_end_hold.cues: Hold a light dumbbell by one end, forearm on your thigh, and keep it upright without tipping.

rx_band_wrist_extension.name: Gentle band wrist extension
rx_band_wrist_extension.cues: Forearm on your thigh, palm down, lift the back of the hand against a light band in the pain-free range.

rx_forearm_rotation_partial.name: Dumbbell forearm rotation
rx_forearm_rotation_partial.cues: Forearm on your thigh, hold a light dumbbell by one end and turn palm up and down, pain-free range only.

rx_iso_neck_flexion.name: Isometric neck flexion
rx_iso_neck_flexion.cues: Palm on your forehead, gently press the head forward into the hand without moving, and hold.

rx_iso_neck_extension.name: Isometric neck extension
rx_iso_neck_extension.cues: Hands behind your head, chin level, press the head gently back into the hands and hold.

rx_wall_head_press.name: Wall head press
rx_wall_head_press.cues: Back to a wall, chin tucked, press the back of your head gently into the wall and hold.

rx_iso_neck_rotation.name: Isometric neck rotation
rx_iso_neck_rotation.cues: Hand on the side of your face, try to turn the head gently into the hand without moving, and hold.

rx_towel_neck_rotation_hold.name: Towel neck turn hold
rx_towel_neck_rotation_hold.cues: Towel behind your head, hold both ends, try to turn the head while the towel stops it; hold gently.

rx_iso_neck_side_bend.name: Isometric neck side bend
rx_iso_neck_side_bend.cues: Hand above your ear, gently press the head sideways into the hand without moving, and hold.

rx_side_lying_head_lift_hold.name: Side-lying head lift hold
rx_side_lying_head_lift_hold.cues: Lie on your side, lift the head just off the pillow keeping the nose forward, and hold briefly.

rx_neck_four_way_hold.name: Four-way neck hold
rx_neck_four_way_hold.cues: Press your head gently into your hand front, back, and each side, holding each without moving.

rx_chin_tuck_rotation.name: Chin-tuck head turn
rx_chin_tuck_rotation.cues: Tuck the chin slightly and turn the head slowly side to side only within the pain-free range.

rx_quadruped_neck_extension.name: Hands-and-knees neck lift
rx_quadruped_neck_extension.cues: On hands and knees, chin tucked, look slowly up a little and back down within the pain-free range.

rx_mcgill_curl_up_hold.name: Curl-up hold
rx_mcgill_curl_up_hold.cues: Lie down, one knee bent, hands under your low back, lift head and shoulders slightly and hold.

rx_dead_bug_hold.name: Dead bug hold
rx_dead_bug_hold.cues: Lie on your back, knees and hips at 90°, low back gently flat, arms up, and hold while breathing.

rx_seated_lean_back_hold.name: Short lean-back hold
rx_seated_lean_back_hold.cues: Sit near the chair edge, arms crossed, lean back a little with a tall spine and hold.

rx_bird_dog_hold.name: Bird dog hold
rx_bird_dog_hold.cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg out level, keep the back still and hold.

rx_glute_squeeze_bridge_hold.name: Glute squeeze bridge hold
rx_glute_squeeze_bridge_hold.cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, squeeze the glutes and lift the hips a little, hold without arching.

rx_hip_hinge_hold.name: Small hip hinge hold
rx_hip_hinge_hold.cues: Soft knees, push the hips back a little with a flat back, hands on thighs, and hold.

rx_pallof_hold.name: Band anti-rotation hold
rx_pallof_hold.cues: Band anchored at your side, press it straight out from your chest and hold without letting the body turn.

rx_seated_rotation_hand_press.name: Seated rotation hand press
rx_seated_rotation_hand_press.cues: Sit tall, hand on the outside of the opposite knee, try to turn while the hand stops you; hold.

rx_side_plank_knees.name: Side plank from knees
rx_side_plank_knees.cues: On your side, elbow under the shoulder, knees bent, lift the hips into a straight line and hold.

rx_wall_hip_press_hold.name: Wall hip press hold
rx_wall_hip_press_hold.cues: Stand side-on to a wall, lift the near knee and press it into the wall, stand tall and hold.

rx_prone_press_up_partial.name: Partial prone press-up
rx_prone_press_up_partial.cues: Lie face down, hands by your shoulders, press the chest up only as far as pain-free, hips down.

rx_pelvic_tilt.name: Pelvic tilt
rx_pelvic_tilt.cues: Lying or sitting, gently flatten the low back by tightening the belly, then relax, pain-free only.

rx_hip_flexor_march_hold.name: March hold
rx_hip_flexor_march_hold.cues: Hold a support, lift one knee to a comfortable height and hold it there, standing tall.

rx_seated_knee_lift_hold.name: Seated thigh press hold
rx_seated_knee_lift_hold.cues: Sit tall, hands on one thigh, press the thigh up into your hands without moving, and hold.

rx_pillow_squeeze.name: Pillow squeeze
rx_pillow_squeeze.cues: Sit or lie with a pillow between your knees, squeeze it gently and hold, then relax.

rx_bridge_pillow_squeeze_hold.name: Bridge hold with pillow
rx_bridge_pillow_squeeze_hold.cues: Pillow between the knees, squeeze it, lift the hips a little and hold without arching the back.

rx_short_copenhagen_hold.name: Short side plank on bench
rx_short_copenhagen_hold.cues: Side plank on your elbow with the top knee on a bench, lift the hips and hold a short time.

rx_iso_hip_external_rotation.name: Isometric hip turn-out
rx_iso_hip_external_rotation.cues: Sit tall, knee bent, press the inside of the ankle into your hand or a chair leg and hold.

rx_iso_hip_internal_rotation.name: Isometric hip turn-in
rx_iso_hip_internal_rotation.cues: Sit tall, knee bent, press the outside of the ankle into your hand or a chair leg and hold.

rx_clamshell_hold.name: Clamshell hold
rx_clamshell_hold.cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, open the top knee a little keeping feet together, and hold.

rx_band_abduction_hold.name: Seated band knee-out hold
rx_band_abduction_hold.cues: Sit with a band around the knees, press them apart a little and hold with feet flat.

rx_supported_single_leg_stance.name: Supported one-leg stand
rx_supported_single_leg_stance.cues: Lightly hold a counter, lift one foot a little and stand tall on the other leg, then switch.

rx_band_clamshell.name: Band clamshell
rx_band_clamshell.cues: Lie on your side with a band above the knees, open the top knee in the pain-free range, lower slowly.

rx_seated_band_abduction.name: Seated band knee-out
rx_seated_band_abduction.cues: Sit with a band around the knees, push them apart in the pain-free range and return slowly.

rx_high_box_squat.name: High box squat
rx_high_box_squat.cues: Sit back to a high chair or box, tap it lightly and stand up, depth only as far as pain-free.
