rx_supported_squat_hold.name: Supported squat hold
rx_supported_squat_hold.cues: Hold a door frame or counter, sit down into a comfortable squat depth and hold, heels down.

rx_high_wall_sit.name: High wall sit
rx_high_wall_sit.cues: Back against a wall, slide down only a little to a pain-free bend and hold, knees over feet.

rx_spanish_squat_hold.name: Band Spanish squat hold
rx_spanish_squat_hold.cues: Heavy band behind the knees anchored in front, sit back with shins upright to a pain-free depth and hold.

rx_split_squat_hold.name: Supported split squat hold
rx_split_squat_hold.cues: Hold a support, staggered stance, lower a little to a pain-free bend and hold, front knee over foot.

rx_terminal_knee_extension_hold.name: Band knee lock-out hold
rx_terminal_knee_extension_hold.cues: Band behind the knee anchored in front, straighten the knee against it and hold, thigh tight.

rx_seated_knee_extension_hold.name: Seated leg straight hold
rx_seated_knee_extension_hold.cues: Sit tall, straighten one knee as far as comfortable, tighten the thigh and hold, then lower.

rx_straight_leg_raise.name: Straight leg raise
rx_straight_leg_raise.cues: Lie on your back, other knee bent, tighten the thigh and lift the straight leg to knee height, lower slowly.

rx_short_arc_quad.name: Short arc knee straighten
rx_short_arc_quad.cues: Lie with a rolled towel under the knee, straighten the lower leg fully, hold a second, lower slowly.

rx_low_step_up.name: Supported low step-up
rx_low_step_up.cues: Hold a rail, step up onto a low step with the whole foot, stand tall, and step down slowly.

rx_iso_ankle_dorsiflexion.name: Isometric ankle pull-up
rx_iso_ankle_dorsiflexion.cues: Seated, put the other heel on top of your foot and try to pull the toes up against it; hold.

rx_iso_ankle_plantarflexion.name: Isometric ankle push-down
rx_iso_ankle_plantarflexion.cues: Seated, press the ball of your foot into a wall or firm surface without moving, and hold.

rx_iso_ankle_inversion.name: Isometric ankle turn-in
rx_iso_ankle_inversion.cues: Seated, press the inside of your foot against the other foot or a chair leg and hold gently.

rx_iso_ankle_eversion.name: Isometric ankle turn-out
rx_iso_ankle_eversion.cues: Seated, press the outside of your foot against a wall or chair leg and hold gently.

rx_calf_raise_hold.name: Supported calf raise hold
rx_calf_raise_hold.cues: Hold a support, rise onto the balls of your feet to a comfortable height and hold.

rx_seated_calf_press_hold.name: Seated heel lift hold
rx_seated_calf_press_hold.cues: Sit tall, lift both heels with hands pressing down on your knees, and hold.

rx_band_ankle_dorsiflexion.name: Band ankle pull-up
rx_band_ankle_dorsiflexion.cues: Seated, band anchored in front around the foot, pull the toes up in the pain-free range, return slowly.

rx_band_ankle_plantarflexion.name: Band ankle push
rx_band_ankle_plantarflexion.cues: Seated, band around the ball of the foot, push the foot down in the pain-free range, return slowly.

rx_partial_calf_raise.name: Partial calf raise
rx_partial_calf_raise.cues: Hold a support and lift the heels only a little, in the pain-free range, then lower slowly.

br_belly_breathing.name: Belly breathing
br_belly_breathing.cues: Hand on your belly; breathe in through the nose so it rises, and breathe out slowly through the mouth.

br_long_exhale.name: Long exhale breathing
br_long_exhale.cues: Breathe in for 4 counts and out for 6 to 8 counts, never holding your breath.

br_side_rib_breathing.name: Rib breathing
br_side_rib_breathing.cues: Hands on your lower ribs; breathe in to widen them sideways, then let them close as you breathe out.

br_lying_relax.name: Lying calm breathing
br_lying_relax.cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and breathe slowly, letting your shoulders and jaw relax.

kid_balloon_breathing.name: Balloon breathing
kid_balloon_breathing.cues: Breathe in slowly to fill a big imaginary balloon, then let the air out gently.

cw_slow_walk_room.name: Slow walk around the room
cw_slow_walk_room.cues: Walk slowly and easily, letting your breathing settle.

cw_slow_step_touch.name: Slow step touch
cw_slow_step_touch.cues: Step side to side slowly, swinging the arms softly, and breathe easy.

cw_easy_bike.name: Easy bike spin
cw_easy_bike.cues: Pedal with light resistance at an easy pace to bring your heart rate down.

cw_seated_slow_march.name: Seated slow march
cw_seated_slow_march.cues: Sitting tall, lift one knee a little, then the other, slowly, breathing easy.

cw_arm_swing_walk.name: Walk with easy arm swings
cw_arm_swing_walk.cues: Walk at a relaxed pace and let the arms swing loosely.

fc_fast_march.name: Fast march
fc_fast_march.cues: March quickly in place, pumping the arms, keeping one foot on the floor.

fc_shadow_boxing.name: Shadow boxing
fc_shadow_boxing.cues: Stand with soft knees and throw light, quick punches, staying on the balls of your feet.

fc_low_impact_jacks.name: Low-impact jacks
fc_low_impact_jacks.cues: Step one foot out while raising the arms, then step back in, alternating sides quickly.

fc_step_touch_fast.name: Quick step touch
fc_step_touch_fast.cues: Step side to side at a brisk pace, adding arm reaches.

fc_skater_steps.name: Skater steps (no jump)
fc_skater_steps.cues: Step wide to one side and bring the other foot behind, then switch, swinging the arms.

fc_seated_punches.name: Seated fast punches
fc_seated_punches.cues: Sitting tall, punch forward quickly with alternating arms, breathing steadily.

fc_seated_fast_march.name: Seated fast march
fc_seated_fast_march.cues: Sitting tall, march your feet quickly and pump the arms.

fc_seated_jacks.name: Seated jacks
fc_seated_jacks.cues: Sitting, tap the feet out to the sides while raising the arms, then back in.

fc_rowing_machine_easy.name: Rowing machine intervals
fc_rowing_machine_easy.cues: Row with long smooth strokes: 30 s steady, 30 s easy, legs first then arms.

fc_bike_intervals.name: Bike intervals
fc_bike_intervals.cues: Pedal 30 s a little harder, then 30 s easy, staying tall on the seat.

wu_seated_arm_swings.name: Seated arm swings
wu_seated_arm_swings.cues: Sitting tall, swing both arms forward and back loosely, getting a little faster.

wu_seated_step_outs.name: Seated step-outs
wu_seated_step_outs.cues: Sitting, step one foot out to the side and back, then the other, in a steady rhythm.

wu_seated_heel_toe_taps_rhythm.name: Seated heel-toe rhythm
wu_seated_heel_toe_taps_rhythm.cues: Sitting, tap heels then toes quickly on the floor, adding arm swings.

seated_palm_press.name: Seated palm press
seated_palm_press.cues: Each rep: sit tall, press your palms together in front of your chest for 5 s, then relax; repeat.

seated_high_palm_press.name: Seated high palm press
seated_high_palm_press.cues: Each rep: sitting, press the palms together at eye level, elbows soft, for 5 s; repeat.

seated_low_palm_press.name: Seated low palm press
seated_low_palm_press.cues: Each rep: sitting, press the palms together low in front of your belly for 5 s; repeat.

seated_hug_squeeze.name: Seated big hug
seated_hug_squeeze.cues: Sitting, round the arms as if hugging a big ball and squeeze for 10 s.

seated_towel_press_up.name: Seated towel press, angled up
seated_towel_press_up.cues: Hold a towel stretched between both hands at chest height, angled up, and pull it apart-hard while pressing forward.

seated_elbow_drive.name: Seated elbow drive
seated_elbow_drive.cues: Sitting tall, pull the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades for 3 s; repeat.

seated_w_squeeze.name: Seated W squeeze
seated_w_squeeze.cues: Each rep: sitting, arms in a W beside you, press the elbows down and back and hold 5 s.

seated_towel_row_hold.name: Seated towel row hold
seated_towel_row_hold.cues: Loop a towel around your feet, sit tall and pull it toward you, squeezing the back for 10 s.

seated_arms_back_lift.name: Seated reverse fly (no weight)
seated_arms_back_lift.cues: Lean forward slightly, arms hanging, lift them out to the sides to shoulder height, and lower slowly.

cw_seated_arm_float.name: Seated slow arm float
cw_seated_arm_float.cues: Sitting, float the arms up in front to shoulder height and down, slowly, with calm breathing.

cw_seated_ankle_pumps.name: Seated easy ankle pumps
cw_seated_ankle_pumps.cues: Sitting, slowly point and flex both feet while your breathing settles.

cw_seated_shoulder_circles_slow.name: Seated slow shoulder circles
cw_seated_shoulder_circles_slow.cues: Sitting tall, roll the shoulders slowly backward in big circles.

fc_seated_twist_taps.name: Seated twist taps
fc_seated_twist_taps.cues: Sitting tall, twist and tap the opposite knee with each hand, quickly and steadily.

fc_seated_heel_drums.name: Seated heel drums
fc_seated_heel_drums.cues: Sitting, drum the heels quickly on the floor while pumping the arms.

fc_seated_reach_ups.name: Seated fast reach-ups
fc_seated_reach_ups.cues: Sitting, reach up with alternating arms at a steady, quick pace.

seated_incline_towel_squeeze.name: Seated towel squeeze, arms high
seated_incline_towel_squeeze.cues: Hold a rolled towel between the palms at eye level and squeeze it for 10 s.

seated_diagonal_press.name: Seated diagonal press
seated_diagonal_press.cues: Each rep: sitting, press one palm up and across against the other hand for 5 s; switch sides.

su_seated_shrug_hold.name: Seated shrug with pause
su_seated_shrug_hold.cues: Sit tall, lift both shoulders toward your ears, hold two seconds, then lower slowly.

su_seated_chair_grip_shrug_hold.name: Chair-grip shrug hold
su_seated_chair_grip_shrug_hold.cues: Grip the sides of your seat and try to lift your shoulders up against it; hold, breathing steadily.

su_seated_y_raise.name: Seated Y raise
su_seated_y_raise.cues: Sit tall, raise straight arms into a Y with thumbs up, draw shoulder blades down, then lower.

su_seated_slow_lateral_raise.name: Seated slow arm raise
su_seated_slow_lateral_raise.cues: Sit tall, lift straight arms out to shoulder height over three seconds, pause, lower slowly.

su_seated_scaption_raise.name: Seated thumbs-up raise
su_seated_scaption_raise.cues: Thumbs up, lift arms forward at a slight angle to shoulder height, keep shoulders down, then lower.

su_seated_towel_overhead_press.name: Seated towel overhead press
su_seated_towel_overhead_press.cues: Hold a towel taut at shoulder height, press it overhead while pulling the ends apart, then lower.

su_seated_elbow_squeeze_fly.name: Seated elbow squeeze fly
su_seated_elbow_squeeze_fly.cues: Arms bent at shoulder height, bring forearms together in front, squeeze your chest, then open.

su_seated_palm_press_slide.name: Seated palm press push-out
su_seated_palm_press_slide.cues: Press palms together hard at your chest, push them forward until arms are nearly straight, then return.

su_doorway_chest_press_hold.name: Doorway chest press hold
su_doorway_chest_press_hold.cues: Stand in a doorway, palms on the frame at chest height, press forward without moving and hold.

su_seated_low_crossover.name: Seated low cross-over
su_seated_low_crossover.cues: Start with arms out wide and slightly high, sweep them down to cross in front of your hips, squeeze.

su_seated_diagonal_palm_press.name: Seated downward palm push
su_seated_diagonal_palm_press.cues: Press palms together at your chest and push them down and forward toward your knees, then return.

su_seated_leg_lift_curl.name: Seated leg-lift curl
su_seated_leg_lift_curl.cues: Sit tall, clasp hands under one thigh and curl it up with your arms, letting the leg relax.

su_seated_reverse_self_curl.name: Self-resisted reverse curl
su_seated_reverse_self_curl.cues: Palm down, curl one hand up while the other hand presses down on its wrist; switch sides.

su_seated_hammer_self_curl.name: Self-resisted hammer curl
su_seated_hammer_self_curl.cues: Thumb up and fist closed, curl one arm while the other hand presses down on top of the fist; switch.

su_seated_towel_overhead_extension.name: Towel overhead triceps press
su_seated_towel_overhead_extension.cues: Top hand holds a towel behind your head, bottom hand resists; straighten the top elbow, then bend.

su_seated_air_kickback.name: Seated no-weight kickback
su_seated_air_kickback.cues: Lean slightly forward, elbows by your ribs, straighten arms back and squeeze hard for a second.

su_seated_table_press_down_hold.name: Table press-down hold
su_seated_table_press_down_hold.cues: Sit at a table, palms flat, elbows slightly bent; press down hard as if to rise and hold.

su_seated_finger_spread_squeeze.name: Fist and finger spread
su_seated_finger_spread_squeeze.cues: Arms forward, make a tight fist for two seconds, then spread fingers wide; repeat at a steady pace.

su_seated_self_resisted_palm_turn.name: Self-resisted palm turn
su_seated_self_resisted_palm_turn.cues: Elbow bent at your side, turn the palm up and down while the other hand grips and resists the wrist.

su_seated_bent_t_raise.name: Seated bent-over T raise
su_seated_bent_t_raise.cues: Hinge forward from the hips, back flat, lift straight arms out into a T with thumbs up, then lower.

su_seated_elbow_pull_back.name: Seated elbow pull-back
su_seated_elbow_pull_back.cues: Elbows bent at shoulder height, pull them back in line with your body, pause, then bring forward.

su_seated_w_pulldown.name: Seated W pulldown
su_seated_w_pulldown.cues: Reach arms overhead, pull elbows down into a W beside your ribs, squeeze your back, then reach up.

su_seated_armrest_press_hold.name: Armrest elbow press hold
su_seated_armrest_press_hold.cues: Sit tall with elbows on the armrests, press them down firmly without shrugging and hold.

su_seated_straight_arm_press_back.name: Seated straight-arm press-back
su_seated_straight_arm_press_back.cues: Sit near the seat edge, arms straight by your sides, sweep palms back past your hips and squeeze.

su_seated_table_edge_pull_hold.name: Table-edge pull hold
su_seated_table_edge_pull_hold.cues: Grip a sturdy table edge, elbows by your sides, pull as if drawing yourself in, and hold.

su_seated_band_overhead_pulldown.name: Seated band pull-apart pulldown
su_seated_band_overhead_pulldown.cues: Hold a band overhead, pull it apart and down in front to chest level, then return with control.

su_seated_band_straight_arm_pulldown.name: Seated band straight-arm pulldown
su_seated_band_straight_arm_pulldown.cues: Band anchored high in front, arms straight, sweep hands down to your thighs, then let them rise slowly.

su_seated_clasped_hands_squeeze.name: Seated clasped-hands squeeze
su_seated_clasped_hands_squeeze.cues: Sit forward, clasp hands behind your low back, squeeze shoulder blades together and lift hands slightly.

su_seated_air_row.name: Seated no-weight row
su_seated_air_row.cues: Lean slightly forward, reach arms ahead, row elbows back past your ribs, squeeze, and reach again.

sl_seated_knee_reach_crunch.name: Seated knee-reach crunch
sl_seated_knee_reach_crunch.cues: Sit tall, exhale and curl your ribs down as your hands slide toward your knees, then roll back up slowly.

sl_seated_abdominal_thigh_press.name: Seated abdominal thigh press
sl_seated_abdominal_thigh_press.cues: Hands on thighs, curl your chest slightly forward and press palms down hard while breathing steadily; do not hold your breath.

sl_seated_crossed_arm_crunch_pulses.name: Seated crossed-arm crunch pulses
sl_seated_crossed_arm_crunch_pulses.cues: Arms crossed on chest, lean back a little, then make small forward crunch pulses with the upper spine, exhaling each time.

sl_seated_double_knee_tuck.name: Seated double knee tuck
sl_seated_double_knee_tuck.cues: Hold the chair seat, lean back slightly and lift both knees toward your chest, then lower your feet slowly.

sl_seated_pelvic_tuck.name: Seated pelvic tuck
sl_seated_pelvic_tuck.cues: Sit tall, then tuck your tailbone under by drawing your lower belly in, pause, and return to neutral.

sl_seated_feet_hover_hold.name: Seated feet hover hold
sl_seated_feet_hover_hold.cues: Hold the chair sides, sit tall and lift both feet just off the floor; keep breathing and lower before your back arches.

sl_seated_torso_twist.name: Seated torso twist
sl_seated_torso_twist.cues: Arms crossed on chest, sit tall and turn your ribs slowly to one side, then the other, keeping hips facing forward.

sl_seated_cross_body_knee_touch.name: Seated cross-body knee touch
sl_seated_cross_body_knee_touch.cues: Hands by your ears, lift one knee and turn to bring the opposite elbow toward it, then switch sides with control.

sl_seated_cross_knee_press_hold.name: Seated cross-knee press hold
sl_seated_cross_knee_press_hold.cues: Place one hand on the opposite knee, press hand and knee into each other without moving, breathe, then switch sides.

sl_seated_straight_leg_raise.name: Seated straight-leg raise
sl_seated_straight_leg_raise.cues: Sit tall, straighten one leg with toes up and lift it a few inches from the floor, then lower slowly.

sl_seated_turned_out_knee_lift.name: Seated turned-out knee lift
sl_seated_turned_out_knee_lift.cues: Turn one knee out and lift that foot toward the opposite shin, keeping your back tall, then lower slowly.

sl_seated_knee_circles.name: Seated knee circles
sl_seated_knee_circles.cues: Lift one knee a little and draw slow small circles with it, both directions, keeping your trunk still.

sl_seated_hands_out_knee_squeeze.name: Seated hand-resisted knee squeeze
sl_seated_hands_out_knee_squeeze.cues: Hands on your inner knees, push outward gently while you slowly squeeze your knees together, then let them open.

sl_seated_towel_ankle_squeeze.name: Seated towel ankle squeeze
sl_seated_towel_ankle_squeeze.cues: Place a rolled towel between your ankles, stretch legs forward with heels down and squeeze the towel; keep breathing.

sl_supported_cross_body_leg_sweep.name: Supported cross-body leg sweep
sl_supported_cross_body_leg_sweep.cues: Hold a chair, stand tall and sweep one straight leg across in front of the other, then back to center slowly.

sl_seated_leg_crossover_lift.name: Seated leg crossover lift
sl_seated_leg_crossover_lift.cues: Lift one foot slightly, move that leg across the midline toward the other side, then back, keeping the foot off the floor.

sl_seated_floor_push_hold.name: Seated floor push hold
sl_seated_floor_push_hold.cues: Feet flat under knees, push them hard into the floor as if to stand, without leaving the seat; breathe and relax.

sl_seated_leg_extension_pulses.name: Seated leg extension pulses
sl_seated_leg_extension_pulses.cues: Straighten one leg, then make small up-and-down pulses near the top without locking the knee; switch legs.

sl_seated_double_leg_extension.name: Seated double leg extension
sl_seated_double_leg_extension.cues: Hold the chair seat, sit tall and straighten both legs together, pause, then bend them back down slowly.

sl_seated_wall_foot_press_hold.name: Seated wall foot press hold
sl_seated_wall_foot_press_hold.cues: Sit facing a wall, place one sole on it with the knee bent, press forward firmly without moving; breathe, then switch.

sl_seated_knee_cocontraction_hold.name: Seated knee brace hold
sl_seated_knee_cocontraction_hold.cues: Foot flat, press the heel down and back while also pushing the knee forward so the thigh tightens all around; hold.

sl_seated_heel_slides.name: Seated heel slides
sl_seated_heel_slides.cues: Slide one heel forward along the floor until the leg is nearly straight, then slide it back under the chair slowly.

sl_seated_knee_tracking_lift.name: Seated slow kneecap-up lift
sl_seated_knee_tracking_lift.cues: Straighten one leg keeping the kneecap pointing straight up, then take five seconds to lower it with control.

sl_seated_shin_rotation_control.name: Seated shin rotation control
sl_seated_shin_rotation_control.cues: Knee bent at a right angle, heel down, slowly turn your toes in and out by rotating the shin, keeping the thigh still.

sl_seated_alternating_toe_taps.name: Seated alternating toe taps
sl_seated_alternating_toe_taps.cues: Heels on the floor, lift and tap the toes of one foot, then the other, at a steady quick rhythm.

sl_seated_inward_toe_lifts.name: Seated inward toe lifts
sl_seated_inward_toe_lifts.cues: Heels down, lift your toes and turn them slightly inward toward each other, pause, then lower slowly.

sl_seated_heel_walks.name: Seated heel walks
sl_seated_heel_walks.cues: With toes lifted, walk your heels forward in small steps until legs are long, then walk them back.

sl_seated_hand_pressed_heel_raise.name: Seated hand-pressed heel raise
sl_seated_hand_pressed_heel_raise.cues: Press both hands down on one knee for resistance and lift that heel as high as you can, then lower slowly.

sl_seated_heel_raise_pulses.name: Seated heel raise pulses
sl_seated_heel_raise_pulses.cues: Lift both heels high, then make small quick pulses at the top before lowering all the way down.

sl_seated_turned_out_heel_raise.name: Seated toes-out heel raise
sl_seated_turned_out_heel_raise.cues: Turn your toes slightly out, heels close together, and lift the heels high, then lower with control.

sl_seated_back_extension.name: Seated back extension
sl_seated_back_extension.cues: Hands on thighs, lift your chest and gently arch your lower back a little, then return to tall sitting.

sl_seated_hip_hinge_hold.name: Seated hip-hinge hold
sl_seated_hip_hinge_hold.cues: Arms crossed, lean forward from the hips with a flat back until slightly tilted, hold while breathing, then sit up.

sl_seated_backrest_press_hold.name: Seated backrest press hold
sl_seated_backrest_press_hold.cues: Sit tall against the backrest and press your back gently into it without slouching; hold, breathe, and relax.

sl_supported_standing_back_extension.name: Supported standing back extension
sl_supported_standing_back_extension.cues: Hold a chair back, squeeze your glutes and gently lift your chest to arch a little, then return to upright.

sl_supported_hip_hinge.name: Supported hip hinge
sl_supported_hip_hinge.cues: Hands on a chair back, push your hips back with a flat back and soft knees, then stand tall by squeezing glutes.

sl_seated_glute_squeeze_hold.name: Seated glute squeeze hold
sl_seated_glute_squeeze_hold.cues: Sit tall and squeeze your buttocks firmly so you rise slightly on the seat; hold, breathe, then relax.

sl_seated_knee_out_press_hold.name: Seated knee-out press hold
sl_seated_knee_out_press_hold.cues: Hands on your outer knees, push the knees out against your hands without moving; hold and keep breathing.

sl_seated_leg_back_floor_press.name: Seated leg-back floor press
sl_seated_leg_back_floor_press.cues: Sit near the edge, slide one foot back beside the chair on the toes, and press it down into the floor; hold, then switch.

sl_seated_clamshell.name: Seated clamshell
sl_seated_clamshell.cues: Feet together on the floor, open your knees apart as far as is comfortable, pause, then close them slowly.

sl_seated_seat_hover_hold.name: Seated seat hover hold
sl_seated_seat_hover_hold.cues: Lean forward with feet under knees and lift your bottom just off the seat, hold briefly, then sit back down softly.

sl_seated_band_leg_back_pull.name: Seated band leg-back pull
sl_seated_band_leg_back_pull.cues: Band around both ankles, sit near the edge and slide one foot back under the chair against the band, then return.

sl_seated_band_clamshell.name: Seated band clamshell
sl_seated_band_clamshell.cues: Band above your knees, feet together, open the knees apart against the band, pause, then close slowly.

sl_seated_heel_dig_hold.name: Seated heel dig hold
sl_seated_heel_dig_hold.cues: Knee slightly bent, dig one heel into the floor and pull it back toward the chair without moving; hold, then switch.

sl_seated_towel_heel_drag.name: Seated towel heel drag
sl_seated_towel_heel_drag.cues: Heel on a towel on a smooth floor, press down and drag the heel back under the chair, then slide it forward.

sl_seated_crossed_ankle_curl_press.name: Seated crossed-ankle curl press
sl_seated_crossed_ankle_curl_press.cues: Cross your ankles, pull the back heel toward the chair while the front leg resists; hold without moving, then switch.

sl_seated_straight_leg_heel_press.name: Seated straight-leg heel press
sl_seated_straight_leg_heel_press.cues: Stretch one leg forward with the heel on the floor and press the heel down firmly; hold, breathe, then switch legs.

sl_seated_heel_back_kicks.name: Seated heel-back kicks
sl_seated_heel_back_kicks.cues: Sit near the edge, lift one foot slightly and curl the heel back under the chair, then extend forward; repeat smoothly.

sl_seated_band_heel_dig_hold.name: Seated band heel-pull hold
sl_seated_band_heel_dig_hold.cues: Band anchored in front around one ankle, pull the heel back under the chair and hold against the band; then switch.

sl_seated_band_double_leg_curl.name: Seated band double-leg curl
sl_seated_band_double_leg_curl.cues: Band anchored in front around both ankles, pull both heels back toward the chair together, then return slowly.

sv_cs_hands_behind_head_chest.name: Chair hands-behind-head chest stretch
sv_cs_hands_behind_head_chest.cues: Sit tall, rest hands lightly behind your head and open elbows wide; never pull on your head.

sv_cs_seat_edge_front_shoulder.name: Seat-edge front shoulder stretch
sv_cs_seat_edge_front_shoulder.cues: Hold the seat edge behind your hips and gently lift your chest until the front of your shoulders stretch.

sv_cs_palms_up_overhead.name: Seated palms-up overhead stretch
sv_cs_palms_up_overhead.cues: Interlace fingers, turn palms up and press gently toward the ceiling while your shoulders stay low.

sv_cs_arm_behind_back_shoulder.name: Seated arm-behind-back stretch
sv_cs_arm_behind_back_shoulder.cues: Rest one hand on your lower back and let the other hand gently guide that wrist toward the opposite hip.

sv_cs_low_cross_arm.name: Seated low cross-arm stretch
sv_cs_low_cross_arm.cues: Bring one arm across your belly and hug it in with the other forearm, keeping that shoulder relaxed.

sv_cs_opposite_knee_reach.name: Seated opposite-knee reach
sv_cs_opposite_knee_reach.cues: Hold the outside of the opposite knee and let your shoulder blade slide forward, breathing slowly.

sv_cs_forearm_press_down.name: Seated forearm press-down stretch
sv_cs_forearm_press_down.cues: Lift one elbow to chest height bent at 90 degrees and let the other hand ease the forearm down a little.

sv_cs_goalpost_hold.name: Seated goalpost stretch
sv_cs_goalpost_hold.cues: Raise arms like a goalpost, elbows at shoulder height, and ease hands back only as far as comfortable.

sv_cs_elbows_in_forearm_open.name: Seated elbows-in forearm opener
sv_cs_elbows_in_forearm_open.cues: Keep elbows at your sides bent 90 degrees and swing forearms outward, then hold where you feel a stretch.

sv_cs_lean_away_back.name: Seated lean-away back stretch
sv_cs_lean_away_back.cues: Hold the seat beside your thigh and lean your upper body gently away until your upper back stretches.

sv_cs_wrist_pull_lat.name: Seated wrist-pull lat stretch
sv_cs_wrist_pull_lat.cues: Raise both arms, hold one wrist and lean gently to the other side, feeling the stretch along your ribs.

sv_cs_diagonal_fold.name: Seated diagonal lat reach
sv_cs_diagonal_fold.cues: Lean forward slowly and slide both hands toward the outside of one foot, keeping your feet flat.

sv_cs_side_lean_lat.name: Seated elbow-high side lean
sv_cs_side_lean_lat.cues: Place one hand behind your head, point that elbow up and lean gently to the other side.

sv_cs_straight_arm_reach_back.name: Seated straight-arm reach-back
sv_cs_straight_arm_reach_back.cues: Sit near the front of the chair, reach straight arms back with thumbs down and hold without leaning.

sv_cs_seat_grip_biceps.name: Seat-grip biceps stretch
sv_cs_seat_grip_biceps.cues: Hold the seat just behind your hip, straighten that arm and turn your chest slightly away.

sv_cs_elbow_up_triceps.name: Seated elbow-to-ceiling stretch
sv_cs_elbow_up_triceps.cues: Reach one hand down your upper back and use the other hand to gently guide that elbow up.

sv_cs_lean_back_belly.name: Seated lean-back belly stretch
sv_cs_lean_back_belly.cues: Place hands on the seat behind you, lift your chest and lean back slightly while looking ahead.

sv_cs_arms_up_arch.name: Seated arms-up arch
sv_cs_arms_up_arch.cues: Interlace hands overhead, lift your chest and arch just a little, keeping your neck long.

sv_cs_diagonal_reach_up.name: Seated diagonal reach-up
sv_cs_diagonal_reach_up.cues: Reach one arm up and slightly back, turning your chest open, while both hips stay on the seat.

sv_cs_single_knee_hug.name: Seated single knee hug
sv_cs_single_knee_hug.cues: Lift one knee, hug it toward your chest and let your lower back round softly; hold the chair if needed.

sv_cs_c_curve_hold.name: Seated C-curve hold
sv_cs_c_curve_hold.cues: Hands on knees, tuck your pelvis and round your back into a C, pushing knees away gently.

sv_cs_knee_across_hug.name: Seated knee-across hug
sv_cs_knee_across_hug.cues: Lift one knee and gently pull it toward the opposite shoulder, keeping your back tall.

sv_cs_crossed_leg_twist.name: Seated crossed-leg glute twist
sv_cs_crossed_leg_twist.cues: Cross one knee over the other, turn toward the top knee and press it gently with the opposite hand.

sv_cs_knee_drop_hip.name: Seated knee-drop hip stretch
sv_cs_knee_drop_hip.cues: Set feet wide and let one knee drop slowly inward toward the other foot, then hold.

sv_cs_frog_leg_opener.name: Seated soles-together hip opener
sv_cs_frog_leg_opener.cues: Scoot forward, bring the soles of your feet together on the floor and let knees fall open gently.

sv_cs_side_leg_adductor.name: Seated side-leg adductor stretch
sv_cs_side_leg_adductor.cues: Slide one leg straight out to the side, toes up, and lean gently toward the bent knee.

sv_cs_elbow_press_groin.name: Seated elbow-press groin stretch
sv_cs_elbow_press_groin.cues: With knees wide and feet flat, lean forward and let your elbows press your inner knees gently apart.

sv_cs_side_sit_quad.name: Chair side-sit quad stretch
sv_cs_side_sit_quad.cues: Sit sideways on the chair, let the outer leg bend back beside the seat and hold the chair for balance.

sv_cs_foot_tuck_quad.name: Seated foot-tuck quad stretch
sv_cs_foot_tuck_quad.cues: Slide one foot back under the chair onto your toes until the front of the thigh stretches.

sv_cs_tucked_feet_lean_back.name: Seated tucked-feet lean-back
sv_cs_tucked_feet_lean_back.cues: Tuck both feet back under the chair, then lean your upper body back slightly against the backrest.

sv_cs_heel_slide_knee_bend.name: Seated heel-slide knee bend
sv_cs_heel_slide_knee_bend.cues: Slide one heel back along the floor until the knee bends comfortably, then hold without pain.

sv_cs_knee_straightening_hold.name: Seated knee-straightening hold
sv_cs_knee_straightening_hold.cues: Rest one heel forward on the floor and press gently on the thigh above the knee, never on the kneecap.

sv_cs_shin_pull_knee_bend.name: Seated shin-pull knee bend
sv_cs_shin_pull_knee_bend.cues: Lift one foot, hold the front of the shin and ease the heel toward the chair, stopping before any pain.

sv_cs_leg_lift_hamstring.name: Seated leg-lift hamstring hold
sv_cs_leg_lift_hamstring.cues: Hold behind one thigh, lift the foot and straighten the knee only until you feel a gentle stretch.

sv_cs_two_leg_hamstring.name: Seated two-leg hamstring stretch
sv_cs_two_leg_hamstring.cues: Sit near the edge, place both heels forward, toes up, and hinge forward from the hips with a long back.

sv_cs_flexed_foot_hold.name: Seated flexed-foot calf hold
sv_cs_flexed_foot_hold.cues: Stretch one leg forward on the heel and pull your toes back toward you, holding the position.

sv_cs_bent_knee_calf.name: Seated bent-knee calf stretch
sv_cs_bent_knee_calf.cues: Slide one foot back a little, keep the heel down and lean the knee forward over the toes.

sv_cs_ankle_cross_shin.name: Seated ankle-over-knee shin stretch
sv_cs_ankle_cross_shin.cues: Rest one ankle on the other knee and gently press the top of the foot to point the toes.

sv_cs_pointed_toe_hold.name: Seated long-leg toe point
sv_cs_pointed_toe_hold.cues: Lift one leg a little in front of you and point your toes long, feeling the front of the ankle.

sv_mo_chair_cat_cow.name: Chair cat-cow
sv_mo_chair_cat_cow.cues: Hands on knees, slowly round your back as you exhale, then lift your chest as you inhale.

sv_mo_crossed_arm_rotations.name: Chair crossed-arm rotations
sv_mo_crossed_arm_rotations.cues: Cross arms on your chest and turn slowly side to side, keeping hips still and knees pointing forward.

sv_mo_overhead_side_reaches.name: Chair overhead side reaches
sv_mo_overhead_side_reaches.cues: Reach one arm up and over to the side, return to center and switch, moving smoothly with your breath.

sv_mo_seated_trunk_circles.name: Seated trunk circles
sv_mo_seated_trunk_circles.cues: Hands on knees, draw slow small circles with your upper body, then reverse the direction.

sv_br_counted_chair_breathing.name: Counted chair breathing
sv_br_counted_chair_breathing.cues: Sit tall, breathe in through your nose for 4 counts and out slowly through your mouth for 6.

sv_br_shoulder_drop_breathing.name: Shoulder-drop breathing
sv_br_shoulder_drop_breathing.cues: Breathe in gently, then let your shoulders drop and soften as you breathe out slowly.

sv_br_humming_exhale.name: Humming exhale breathing
sv_br_humming_exhale.cues: Breathe in through your nose, then hum softly with lips closed for a long, easy breath out.

sv_cw_seated_walking_arms.name: Seated slow march with arm swing
sv_cw_seated_walking_arms.cues: Lift your feet slowly in turn while swinging the opposite arm, letting your breathing settle.

sv_cw_seated_foot_shuffle.name: Seated foot shuffle
sv_cw_seated_foot_shuffle.cues: Slide one foot forward and the other back along the floor, switching at an easy, slowing pace.

sv_fc_seated_uppercuts.name: Seated quick uppercuts
sv_fc_seated_uppercuts.cues: Sit tall and throw quick upward punches, alternating arms and turning slightly from your ribs.

sv_fc_seated_knee_elbow_taps.name: Seated knee-to-elbow taps
sv_fc_seated_knee_elbow_taps.cues: Lift one knee and bring the opposite elbow toward it, then switch sides at a brisk, steady pace.

sv_fc_seated_sprint_arms.name: Seated sprint with arm pump
sv_fc_seated_sprint_arms.cues: Run your feet fast on the floor while pumping bent arms, holding the chair edge if you feel unsteady.

kid_chair_rainbow_stretch.name: Rainbow arch stretch
kid_chair_rainbow_stretch.cues: Sit tall, sweep one arm up and over your head like a rainbow and hold while you count to five.

kid_sleepy_turtle_stretch.name: Sleepy turtle stretch
kid_sleepy_turtle_stretch.cues: Fold forward over your lap like a turtle going into its shell, arms hanging loose, and breathe slowly.

kid_flower_candle_breathing.name: Smell the flower, blow the candle
kid_flower_candle_breathing.cues: Breathe in slowly through your nose like smelling a flower, then blow out gently like a candle.

rp_band_ir_short_arc.name: Short-arc band inward turn
rp_band_ir_short_arc.cues: Elbow at your side, pull the band a short way toward your belly, only as far as it stays pain-free.

rp_side_lying_ir_small.name: Side-lying small inward turn
rp_side_lying_ir_small.cues: Lie on your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, and lift your forearm toward your belly in a small pain-free arc.

rp_light_suitcase_walk.name: Light short suitcase walk
rp_light_suitcase_walk.cues: Hold a light weight in one hand, stand tall and walk a few short steps, then set it down before it strains.

rp_short_farmer_walk.name: Short-distance farmer walk
rp_short_farmer_walk.cues: Hold light weights at your sides, shoulders back and down, and walk a short distance at an easy pace.

rp_supine_nod_small.name: Lying small chin nod lift
rp_supine_nod_small.cues: Lie on your back, tuck your chin and lift your head just off the floor in a small pain-free range.

rp_prone_head_lift_small.name: Face-down small head lift
rp_prone_head_lift_small.cues: Lie face down on your forearms, chin tucked, and lift your head a little, keeping the range pain-free.

rp_seated_neck_extension_arc.name: Seated small look-up
rp_seated_neck_extension_arc.cues: Sit tall, tuck your chin, then tilt your head back only a short way and return slowly.

rp_seated_neck_turn_arc.name: Seated small head turns
rp_seated_neck_turn_arc.cues: Sit tall and turn your head side to side in a short range that stays pain-free, eyes level.

rp_quadruped_head_turn_small.name: Hands-and-knees small head turns
rp_quadruped_head_turn_small.cues: On hands and knees with a long neck, turn your head a little to each side without dropping it.

rp_seated_side_tilt_arc.name: Seated small ear tilts
rp_seated_side_tilt_arc.cues: Sit tall and tilt one ear a short way toward your shoulder, then the other, without lifting the shoulders.

rp_side_lying_head_lift_small.name: Side-lying small head lift
rp_side_lying_head_lift_small.cues: Lie on your side with a pillow under your head and lift your head slightly off it, pain-free.

rp_band_neck_tilt_short.name: Band neck tilt, short range
rp_band_neck_tilt_short.cues: With a light band around your head held to the side, tilt away a short pain-free distance and return slowly.

rp_bench_kettlebell_lift.name: Raised kettlebell deadlift
rp_bench_kettlebell_lift.cues: Set the kettlebell on a step or low bench, hinge at the hips with a flat back and stand up tall.

rp_chair_height_dumbbell_lift.name: Chair-height dumbbell lift
rp_chair_height_dumbbell_lift.cues: Lift a light dumbbell from a chair seat by bending at the hips, back flat, then stand tall.

rp_side_lying_adduction_small.name: Side-lying small inner leg lift
rp_side_lying_adduction_small.cues: Lie on your side, top foot in front, and lift the bottom leg a few centimeters, pain-free.

rp_short_arc_clamshell.name: Short-arc clamshell
rp_short_arc_clamshell.cues: Lie on your side, knees bent, and open the top knee only partway, keeping the pelvis still.

rp_cushion_half_kneel_rise.name: Cushioned half-kneel rise
rp_cushion_half_kneel_rise.cues: Kneel on one knee on a thick cushion, hold a support, and push up to standing through the front leg.

rp_tall_kneel_hip_hinge.name: Cushioned tall-kneel hinge
rp_tall_kneel_hip_hinge.cues: Kneel upright on a thick cushion, sit your hips back a little, then squeeze your glutes to rise tall.

rp_low_step_up.name: Ankle-high step-up
rp_low_step_up.cues: Step onto a low step, about ankle height, holding a rail, and step down slowly with control.

rp_quarter_pivot_step.name: Quarter-turn pivot step
rp_quarter_pivot_step.cues: Holding a support, turn a quarter on the ball of one foot, knee soft and over the toes, then turn back.

rp_supported_heel_pivot.name: Supported small foot pivots
rp_supported_heel_pivot.cues: Hold a counter, rise slightly onto the ball of one foot and swivel the heel in and out a little.

rp_slow_angled_step.name: Slow angled cutting step
rp_slow_angled_step.cues: Walk forward and step off at a small angle, knee in line with the toes, moving slowly and controlled.

rp_supported_mini_hops.name: Supported mini hops
rp_supported_mini_hops.cues: Hold a counter and do tiny, quiet hops a few centimeters high, landing softly on the balls of your feet.

rp_soft_heel_drops.name: Soft heel drops
rp_soft_heel_drops.cues: Rise onto your toes a little, then drop gently onto your heels with soft knees, holding a support.

rp_small_line_hops.name: Small forward-back line hops
rp_small_line_hops.cues: Hop low over a line forward and back with both feet, landing quietly with bent knees.

rp_band_ir_full.name: Full-range band inward turn
rp_band_ir_full.cues: Elbow at your side, turn your forearm all the way in against the band, then return slowly.

rp_side_lying_ir_dumbbell.name: Side-lying dumbbell inward turn
rp_side_lying_ir_dumbbell.cues: Lie on the working side, elbow bent at 90 degrees, and lift a light dumbbell toward your belly.

rp_band_ir_90.name: Band inward turn at 90°
rp_band_ir_90.cues: Arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent at 90 degrees, rotate your forearm forward and down against the band.

rp_band_er_90.name: Band outward turn at 90°
rp_band_er_90.cues: Arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent at 90 degrees, rotate your forearm up and back against the band.

rp_band_behind_back_lift.name: Band hand-behind-back lift
rp_band_behind_back_lift.cues: Band anchored low behind you, slide your hand up your back as far as is comfortable, then lower slowly.

rp_dumbbell_forearm_turns.name: Dumbbell palm-up palm-down turns
rp_dumbbell_forearm_turns.cues: Forearm on your thigh, hold a light dumbbell and turn your palm fully up, then fully down, slowly.

rp_band_neck_nod.name: Band-resisted neck nod
rp_band_neck_nod.cues: Light band behind your head held in front, tuck your chin and bring it toward your chest, then return.

rp_supine_head_lift_full.name: Lying chin-to-chest lift
rp_supine_head_lift_full.cues: Lie on your back, tuck your chin and curl your head up toward your chest, then lower slowly.

rp_hand_resisted_neck_four_way.name: Hand-resisted neck moves
rp_hand_resisted_neck_four_way.cues: Press your hand gently against your head as you move it forward, back and to each side through full range.

rp_band_neck_extension.name: Band-resisted neck extension
rp_band_neck_extension.cues: Light band around your forehead held in front, chin level, move your head back and return slowly.

rp_prone_head_lift_full.name: Face-down full head lift
rp_prone_head_lift_full.cues: Lie face down, forehead down, and lift your head until you look ahead, then lower with control.

rp_band_neck_turn.name: Band-resisted head turn
rp_band_neck_turn.cues: Light band around your head held to one side, turn your head fully away against it, then return slowly.

rp_hand_resisted_head_turn.name: Hand-resisted head turn
rp_hand_resisted_head_turn.cues: Hand on the side of your face, turn your head fully to that side while your hand pushes back gently.

rp_quadruped_head_turn_full.name: Hands-and-knees full head turns
rp_quadruped_head_turn_full.cues: On hands and knees with a long neck, turn your head fully to look over each shoulder, slowly.

rp_band_neck_tilt_full.name: Band neck tilt, full range
rp_band_neck_tilt_full.cues: Light band around your head held to the side, tilt your ear fully toward the far shoulder and return slowly.

rp_side_lying_head_lift_full.name: Side-lying full head lift
rp_side_lying_head_lift_full.cues: Lie on your side with no pillow and lift your ear toward the ceiling shoulder, then lower slowly.

rp_controlled_roll_up.name: Slow controlled roll-up
rp_controlled_roll_up.cues: Lie on your back and roll up one segment at a time to sitting, then roll down slowly with control.

rp_slow_reverse_crunch.name: Slow reverse crunch
rp_slow_reverse_crunch.cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, and curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly.

rp_prone_back_raise.name: Face-down back raise
rp_prone_back_raise.cues: Lie face down, hands by your ears, and lift your chest off the floor, neck long, then lower slowly.

rp_bench_back_extension.name: Bench back extension
rp_bench_back_extension.cues: Lie face down with hips on a bench, a partner or strap holding your legs, and lift your trunk to level.

rp_prone_swimmer_lift.name: Prone swimmer lift
rp_prone_swimmer_lift.cues: Lie face down, arms overhead, and lift the opposite arm and leg together, then switch, keeping it slow.

rp_band_trunk_rotation.name: Standing band trunk turn
rp_band_trunk_rotation.cues: Band anchored at chest height to your side, arms straight, turn your trunk fully away and return slowly.

rp_cable_woodchop.name: Cable high-to-low chop
rp_cable_woodchop.cues: Pull the cable from high on one side down across your body, turning your trunk and pivoting the back foot.

rp_band_low_to_high_lift.name: Band low-to-high lift
rp_band_low_to_high_lift.cues: Band anchored low on one side, pull it up and across your body as you turn your trunk, then return slowly.

rp_dumbbell_side_bend.name: Standing dumbbell side bend
rp_dumbbell_side_bend.cues: Hold a dumbbell at one side, bend sideways toward it through full range, then pull back up with the other side.

rp_side_lying_trunk_raise.name: Side-lying trunk raise
rp_side_lying_trunk_raise.cues: Lie on your side with feet held under a sofa and lift your shoulder off the floor, then lower slowly.

rp_band_side_bend.name: Band standing side bend
rp_band_side_bend.cues: Stand on a band holding its end at your side and bend away from it through full range, then return.

rp_kettlebell_deadlift_floor.name: Kettlebell floor deadlift
rp_kettlebell_deadlift_floor.cues: Kettlebell between your feet, hinge with a flat back, grip it and stand up tall by driving the hips forward.

rp_dumbbell_rdl_full.name: Full-range dumbbell RDL
rp_dumbbell_rdl_full.cues: Hold dumbbells, knees soft, push your hips back and lower them to mid-shin with a flat back, then stand.

rp_band_side_lying_abduction.name: Band side-lying leg lift
rp_band_side_lying_abduction.cues: Lie on your side with a band above your knees and lift the top leg fully, toes forward, then lower slowly.

rp_cable_hip_abduction.name: Cable standing leg out
rp_cable_hip_abduction.cues: Cuff on the far ankle, hold the frame and move the leg out to the side fully, trunk upright.

rp_band_standing_adduction.name: Band standing leg in
rp_band_standing_adduction.cues: Band anchored low to your side around the near ankle, sweep the leg across in front of the other one.

rp_cable_hip_adduction.name: Cable standing leg in
rp_cable_hip_adduction.cues: Cuff on the near ankle, hold the frame and pull the leg across in front of your body, trunk upright.

rp_band_clamshell_full.name: Full-range band clamshell
rp_band_clamshell_full.cues: Lie on your side with a band above your knees and open the top knee as far as you can, pelvis still.

rp_band_seated_hip_in_turn.name: Seated band hip inward turn
rp_band_seated_hip_in_turn.cues: Sit tall, band around one ankle pulling inward, and swing the foot out while the knee stays still.

rp_band_seated_hip_out_turn.name: Seated band hip outward turn
rp_band_seated_hip_out_turn.cues: Sit tall, band around one ankle pulling outward, and swing the foot in while the knee stays still.

rp_weighted_kneel_to_stand.name: Weighted kneel-to-stand
rp_weighted_kneel_to_stand.cues: Holding light dumbbells, lower one knee to a mat, then drive up through the front foot to standing.

rp_dumbbell_step_up.name: Dumbbell bench step-up
rp_dumbbell_step_up.cues: Holding dumbbells, step onto a knee-height bench, stand tall on top and step down slowly.

rp_lateral_step_down.name: Slow lateral step-down
rp_lateral_step_down.cues: Stand sideways on a step and slowly lower the free heel to the floor, knee over toes, then press back up.

rp_half_turn_pivot_step.name: Half-turn pivot step
rp_half_turn_pivot_step.cues: Pivot a half turn on the ball of one foot, knee bent and tracking over the toes, then pivot back.

rp_band_lateral_shuffle.name: Band lateral shuffle
rp_band_lateral_shuffle.cues: Band above your knees, sit in a half squat and shuffle side to side, changing direction with control.

rp_cone_cutting_steps.name: Angled cutting drill
rp_cone_cutting_steps.cues: Jog a few steps, plant the outside foot and cut at 45 degrees, knee over toes, then jog on.

rp_lateral_line_hops.name: Side-to-side line hops
rp_lateral_line_hops.cues: Hop side to side over a line with both feet, landing softly with bent knees, at a steady rhythm.

rp_pogo_hops.name: Springy pogo hops
rp_pogo_hops.cues: Bounce quickly on the balls of your feet with stiff ankles and slightly bent knees, landing quietly.

rp_single_leg_hop_stick.name: Single-leg hop and stick
rp_single_leg_hop_stick.cues: Hop forward a short way on one leg and land softly, holding the landing for two seconds, knee over toes.

sf_seated_prayer_press_pulses.name: Seated prayer press pulses
sf_seated_prayer_press_pulses.cues: Press palms together at chest height, push them forward and back in small pulses, keeping the squeeze.

sf_seated_fist_knee_squeeze.name: Seated fist knee squeeze
sf_seated_fist_knee_squeeze.cues: Sit tall with both fists between your knees and squeeze them together for 3 seconds, then relax.

sf_seated_back_arch_reach.name: Seated back arch reach
sf_seated_back_arch_reach.cues: Sit on the front of the chair, lean slightly forward, then lift your chest and reach your arms forward, back tall.

sf_seated_hip_hinge_lift.name: Seated hip hinge lift
sf_seated_hip_hinge_lift.cues: Hands on thighs, hinge forward from the hips with a flat back, then lift back up by tightening your lower back.

sv_seated_backrest_chest_opener.name: Seated backrest chest opener
sv_seated_backrest_chest_opener.cues: Sit tall, hold the sides of the backrest behind you and gently lift your chest until you feel a stretch.

sv_seated_knee_hug_glute.name: Seated knee hug
sv_seated_knee_hug_glute.cues: Sit tall, lift one knee and hug it gently toward your chest; hold, breathe, then switch sides.

sv_seated_cross_knee_glute.name: Seated cross-knee glute pull
sv_seated_cross_knee_glute.cues: Sit tall, cross one knee over the other and pull it gently toward the opposite shoulder; hold, then switch.

sv_seated_sky_reach_belly.name: Seated sky reach
sv_seated_sky_reach_belly.cues: Sit tall, interlace your fingers, reach up and slightly back, feel the front of your belly lengthen; breathe.

sv_seated_hands_on_knees_lift.name: Seated chest-lift belly stretch
sv_seated_hands_on_knees_lift.cues: Hands on knees, press them gently, lift your chest and look slightly up to stretch the lower belly; breathe.

bal_seated_head_turns.name: Seated head turns
bal_seated_head_turns.cues: Sit tall away from the backrest, feet flat; slowly turn your head side to side while your trunk stays still.

bal_seated_knee_lift_hold.name: Seated knee lift hold
bal_seated_knee_lift_hold.cues: Sit tall at the front of the chair, lift one knee a little and hold without leaning back; switch.

bal_seated_arms_up_hold.name: Seated arms-up hold
bal_seated_arms_up_hold.cues: Sit tall away from the backrest, raise both arms forward to shoulder height and hold steady; breathe.

wu_seated_heel_toe_rocks.name: Seated heel-toe rocks
wu_seated_heel_toe_rocks.cues: Sit tall, feet flat; lift your toes, then your heels, in a slow easy rhythm.

wu_seated_knee_lifts.name: Seated knee lifts
wu_seated_knee_lifts.cues: Sit tall at the front of the chair and lift one knee a little, then the other, like a slow march.

wu_seated_toe_taps.name: Seated toe taps
wu_seated_toe_taps.cues: Sit tall, straighten one leg a little and tap the toes forward, then switch, in an easy rhythm.

st_seated_behind_back_triceps.name: Seated behind-the-back triceps stretch
st_seated_behind_back_triceps.cues: Sit tall, rest the back of one hand on your lower back, then gently draw that elbow forward with the other hand. Breathe; switch sides.

squat.name: Sit-to-stand (30 s)
squat.how: Sit on a chair, arms crossed. Stand up fully and sit back down as many times as you can in 30 seconds. Count each full stand.

single_leg_balance.name: Single-leg balance
single_leg_balance.how: Stand on one leg, hands on hips, eyes open. Time how long you hold before the other foot touches down. Then the other leg.

glute_bridge_hold.name: Glute bridge hold
glute_bridge_hold.how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips into a straight line from knees to shoulders and hold.

front_plank.name: Front plank
front_plank.how: Forearms and toes on the floor, body straight from head to heels. Hold without letting the hips sag.

shoulder_reach.name: Overhead shoulder reach
shoulder_reach.how: Stand with your back against a wall. Raise one straight arm overhead. Can the back of your hand touch the wall without arching your back? Then the other arm.

mistakes.horizontal_push: Letting the lower back arch or the hips sag. Elbows flaring straight out to the sides.
mistakes.vertical_push: Arching the lower back to press. Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
mistakes.horizontal_pull: Rounding the back or jerking the weight. Pulling with the arms only, not the shoulder blades.
mistakes.vertical_pull: Swinging the body. Stopping halfway instead of a full, controlled range.
mistakes.squat: Knees caving in. Heels lifting off the floor.
mistakes.hinge: Rounding the lower back. Bending the knees into a squat instead of pushing the hips back.
mistakes.lunge: Front knee drifting inward. Leaning the chest far forward.
mistakes.knee_flexion: Lifting the hips to finish the curl. Letting the weight drop fast.
mistakes.knee_extension: Kicking the weight up with a jerk. Locking the knee hard at the top.
mistakes.calf: Bouncing at the bottom. Only half lifting the heels.
mistakes.ankle: Rushing the movement. Rolling onto the outside of the foot.
mistakes.hip_isolation: Leaning the trunk to cheat the lift. Moving too fast to feel the hip work.
mistakes.shoulder_isolation: Shrugging to lift. Swinging the weight with the body.
mistakes.elbow_flexion: Swinging the elbows forward. Leaning back to lift.
mistakes.elbow_extension: Letting the elbows drift out. Moving the shoulders instead of the elbows.
mistakes.wrist: Using a weight that's too heavy. Moving the forearm instead of the wrist.
mistakes.core_flexion: Pulling on the neck. Using momentum instead of the belly.
mistakes.core_stability: Holding the breath. Letting the lower back sag.
mistakes.rotation: Twisting from the lower back only. Moving too fast.
mistakes.cardio: Starting too fast. Holding the breath.
mistakes.mobility: Forcing the range. Holding the breath.
mistakes.stretch: Bouncing into the stretch. Pushing into pain.
mistakes.balance: Looking down at the feet. Locking the standing knee.
mistakes.breathing: Lifting the shoulders to breathe in. Rushing the exhale.
